faqs.question: How is the placement facility at IIT Bombay?
faqs.answer: The average and median packages offered during IIT Bombay placements 2024 stood at INR 23.5 LPA and INR 17.92 LPA, respectively. The overall placement rate recorded during IIT Bombay placements 2024 was 74.53% with 1,475 students participating in the process out of 1,979 students. A total of 930 students registered,  819 students participated and 683 students were placed durinng BTech placements 2024. The placement percentage went this low because of minimal or no participation in the placement process from over 400 students. Most of them went for higher studies, such as MS / MTech / PhD and MBA courses, while many opted for entrepreneurship or civil services.

faqs.question: Which course is best in IIT Bombay?
faqs.answer: IIT Bombay is one of the top Engineering institute in the country. It is ranked by various bodies. National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) has ranked IIT Bombay, #3 in the "Engineering" category. BTech is the flagship programme of the institute. Moreover, the institute also offers MBA programme. IIT Bombay is also well-known for its Management course. It has secured #10 position in the NIRF 2024 rankings in the Management category.

college_info.intro:
The popular IIT Bombay courses include BTech in CSE, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering. These are the most popular programmes offered by IIT Bombay, with over a lakh applications every year. The IIT Bombay BTech programme is designed to provide students with a strong foundation in Computer Science and Engineering and prepares them for a career in Software Development, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Design, or Automotive Engineering. IIT Bombay also offers a free online Aerospace Engineering programme. IIT Bombay MBA is also a popular choice, other than BTech. In addition to this, IIT Bombay also offers professional certificate programmes in Cybersecurity and Software Development. These courses are being offered by the IITB Trust Lab.

placements.overview:
The highest package offered during IIT Bombay placements 2025 was INR 2.2 Crore per annum More than 50 companies participated in the 2025 placement drive. On Day 1, 258 PPO's were offered at IIT Bombay.

The average package and median package offered during IIT Bombay placements 2024 was INR 23.5 LPA and INR 17.92 LPA, respectively. In addition, the overall placement rate recorded during IIT Bombay placements 2024 was 74.53%. A total of 1,979 participated for placements and 1,475 students accepted offers during IIT Bombay placement 2024. Apart from this, 22 students received offers above INR 1 crore per annum during IIT Bombay placements 2024.

Other than this, the overall placement rate recorded during BTech and Dual Degree (BTech + MTech) placements 2024 was 83.39% and 79.16%, respectively. Moreover, a total of 415 students were placed out of 497 participating students during IIT Bombay MTech placements 2024. Further, the placement rate recorded during IIT Bombay MTech placements 2024 was 83.5%.

reviews_list.batch_info: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: IIT Bombay—it's a dream college.

review_content.Placements: The campus placements at IIT Bombay are good; we can apply for any company irrespective of our branch. Students are eligible for placements from the 7th semester onwards. There are no companies that visited IIT Bombay but did not offer. The highest package ever recorded was around 4.5cr; it was in Fintech (developing algorithms). 75-80 per cent of the students get placed every year. The college provides good internship opportunities. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Idea Forge, and many more offer various roles such as developer, research engineer, etc. The stipend is around 15,000 per month.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied due to the many opportunities present in this college.

review_content.Placements: 70 to 80 percent student got placed and another 5 to 10 percent students do something else. The rest are unplaced. The highest package differs year by year but stays around 1 LPA. The lowest package is around 6 or 7 LPA and the average packages are around 22 to 23 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are non core like McKinsey, Accenture, SDE recruiting companies, Consulting like Revolut, Deloitte etc. The internship percentage is not that high and lies around 40 to 50 percent no data from companies. Top roles are Data Scientist, SDE, Consultant etc. SDE roles are the top choice of students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: Review of IIT Bombay - Indian Institute of Technology.

review_content.Placements: Many students got placed in our college. The highest package is 17 LPA. The lowest package is 3 LPA. Top companies visit our college to recruit students. Almost 95% of students get an internship every year.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in this course are so good. Wi-Fi and classroom as well as a library are present in this college. The food quality in this course is so good. Medical is available and sports and games are present in this course.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers in my college are very helpful and qualified. They have great teaching qualities. The course curriculum is relevant. Students are not fully industry-ready. The semester exam in this course is so easy therefore pass percentage is more than 60% in this course.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Excellent placements, world-class faculty, tough but fair academics, & campus life are hard to beat.

review_content.Placements: Around 80 to 90 percent of students from our batch opted for placements. Majority of them are successfully placed. While others chose higher studies, research, startups, or civil services preparation. The highest package offered in our course went above 1 crore per annum (international offers). The average package is around 20 LPA to 25 LPA, and the lowest package is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Qualcomm, etc. Around 70-80% of students are able to secure internships through campus and off-campus opportunities.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. + Ph.D. in Operations Research - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: IIT Bombay dual degree review.

review_content.Placements: The placement in our course is extremely good. The highest package offered in our course is 52 LPA. The average package is around 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Devex, Org India, etc. Almost all students got internship offers. Top roles are scientists.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi facility is available. Modern classroom and world-class infrastructure. Library with an automated entry and exit system. The hostel quality was like a premium hotel. Mess and canteen food are excellent.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Four years heavenly life.

review_content.Placements: During campus placement at my college 90% of students from my department got placed. The highest package offered is 80LPA and the average CTC is something around 12 to 13 LPA. Mass hiring companies for civil services are Godrej and ICICI Bank. 70% got internship. Top role offered was a Data Scientist Role.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classroom is fully equipped with Wi-Fi and AC. The college has a central library where all kinds of books are available. The food and other facilities like gym culture room TV room everything is good. Time to time a special dinner is provided in the mess. All states' major festivals are celebrated in college.

The faculty members in the department represent diverse areas of expertise and have considerable experience teaching with an emphasis on research skills while accommodating disciplinary crossovers with ease. This is especially important since many of the concerns of the Humanities and Social Sciences requireamulti-disciplinary approach. Our students have been successful both in working at the interfaces of different areas and in transcending traditional disciplinary boundaries in their work. The programme combines course work to build student competence in specific areas, research training, and researchmodules for independent work. Students are expected to carry out a successful programme of research within the duration of the programme. The internal structure of the programme is designed to be quite different from course intensive postgraduate programmes and allows for relative flexibility interms of student backgrounds and prior training

overview_faqs.question: Does IIT Bombay provides remission of fees?
overview_faqs.answer: The students whose gross income of parents for the previous financial year is not more than INR 5 LPA are eligible to apply for Remission of fees. EWS students can also apply for full remission provided their parental income is less than INR 1 Lacs per annum. Two-third of fee is refunded in case where parental income is between INR 1 Lacs and INR 5 Lacs per annum.

overview_faqs.question: Is IIT Bombay hostel security deposit refundable?
overview_faqs.answer: Hostel and mess security deposit is a one-time fee during the entire duration of the student's stay in the hostel. Yes, the amount is refunded on vacating the hostel provided the concerned student is not charged with any fine for hostel/ mess damage. In case a student withdraws admission after paying the hostel fee, he or she is refunded fee after deduction of processing fee of INR 1,000.

overview_faqs.question: Is there a separate application fee for B.Tech at IIT Bombay apart from JEE Mains fee?
overview_faqs.answer: IIT Bombay BTech admission is through JEE Main and Advanced only. There is no separate application fee of the institute. To take the JEE Mains examination, students should pay the application fee. JEE Main application fee is between Rs 500 and 1000 depending upon the gender and category of students. Students who qualify Mains become eligible to take the JEE Advanced exam. The application fee for JEE Advanced is Rs 1600 for female and reserved category candidates, and INR 3200 for other candidates. The fee payment can be done online.

review_summary.college_name: IIT Bombay Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: IIT Bombay—it's a dream college.

content.Placements: The campus placements at IIT Bombay are good; we can apply for any company irrespective of our branch. Students are eligible for placements from the 7th semester onwards. There are no companies that visited IIT Bombay but did not offer. The highest package ever recorded was around 4.5cr; it was in Fintech (developing algorithms). 75-80 per cent of the students get placed every year. The college provides good internship opportunities. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Idea Forge, and many more offer various roles such as developer, research engineer, etc. The stipend is around 15,000 per month.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied due to the many opportunities present in this college.

content.Placements: 70 to 80 percent student got placed and another 5 to 10 percent students do something else. The rest are unplaced. The highest package differs year by year but stays around 1 LPA. The lowest package is around 6 or 7 LPA and the average packages are around 22 to 23 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are non core like McKinsey, Accenture, SDE recruiting companies, Consulting like Revolut, Deloitte etc. The internship percentage is not that high and lies around 40 to 50 percent no data from companies. Top roles are Data Scientist, SDE, Consultant etc. SDE roles are the top choice of students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Review of IIT Bombay - Indian Institute of Technology.

content.Placements: Many students got placed in our college. The highest package is 17 LPA. The lowest package is 3 LPA. Top companies visit our college to recruit students. Almost 95% of students get an internship every year.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in this course are so good. Wi-Fi and classroom as well as a library are present in this college. The food quality in this course is so good. Medical is available and sports and games are present in this course.
content.Faculty: Teachers in my college are very helpful and qualified. They have great teaching qualities. The course curriculum is relevant. Students are not fully industry-ready. The semester exam in this course is so easy therefore pass percentage is more than 60% in this course.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Excellent placements, world-class faculty, tough but fair academics, & campus life are hard to beat.

content.Placements: Around 80 to 90 percent of students from our batch opted for placements. Majority of them are successfully placed. While others chose higher studies, research, startups, or civil services preparation. The highest package offered in our course went above 1 crore per annum (international offers). The average package is around 20 LPA to 25 LPA, and the lowest package is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Qualcomm, etc. Around 70-80% of students are able to secure internships through campus and off-campus opportunities.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. + Ph.D. in Operations Research - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: IIT Bombay dual degree review.

content.Placements: The placement in our course is extremely good. The highest package offered in our course is 52 LPA. The average package is around 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Devex, Org India, etc. Almost all students got internship offers. Top roles are scientists.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi facility is available. Modern classroom and world-class infrastructure. Library with an automated entry and exit system. The hostel quality was like a premium hotel. Mess and canteen food are excellent.

admission_overview.title: IIT Bombay Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: IIT Bombay admissions are quite competitive. IIT Bombay comes under top IITs and is also ranked at '3' under the 'Engineering' category in NIRF 2025 rankings. Admission to its flagship BTech programme requires candidates to have a high JEE rank. With lakh of students appearing for JEE and only a few getting admission, it is required to prepare well-in advance. Aspirants need to pass JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced to get into BTech programme of IIT Bombay. Admission to all other programmes of IIT Bombay is also entrance-based. The institute offers MTech, MSc, MBA, BDes, MDes, etc. through its various schools. The institute accepts scores in GATE for MTech, CAT for MBA, IIT JAM for MSc, UCEED for BDes and CEED for admission to MDes programme.

Students interested in getting admission to IIT Bombay can submit the online application form for the course-specific entrance exam or college, depending on the course they wish to get into.
Step 2: IIT Bombay University Selection Criteria & Release of Merit List

After completion of the registration process, applicants need to go through the course-based entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are completed, they need to go through the course-wise counselling process for final seat allocation. For BDes admission, aspirants need to pass UCEED exam. faqs.question: Does IIT Bombay accept CEED for MDes?

placement_data.title: IIT Bombay Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: According to media reports, the highest package offered during IIT Bombay placements 2025 was INR 2.2 Crore per annum. Further, more than 50 companies participated, and 258 PPOs were offered on Day 1 of IIT Bombay placements 2025.

As of 2024 placement drive, the average salary package offered was INR 23.5 LPA . The median salary package offered was INR 17.92 LPA . IIT Bombay placement percentage recorded was 74.53% , wherein a total of 1,475 candidates participated in the placement process. The number of students registered was 1,979 . 930 students registered, 819 students participated and 683 students were placed during BTech Placements 2024

MBA placement rate recorded in 2024 was 100% . IIT Bombay MBA highest package offered was INR 72 LPA whereas the average package stood at INR 28.01 LPA . During IITB MTech placement drive 2024, 564 students registered, 497 students participated and 415 students were placed.

A total of 1,650 offers were made out of which 78 were international offers during the placement drive 2024. 364 companies visited the campus in 2024 as well. Engineering and Technology sector was the top sector wherein 430 students were placed and 106 companies visited the campus. Download: IIT Bombay Placement Report 2024

reviews.review_heading: IIT Bombay—it's a dream college.
reviews.review_text: There are gyms in every hostel and a central library that is very accessible. They generally close at 11 pm. The cafeteria and canteens are open till 4 am. The classrooms have smart screens, which aid in understanding. IIT Bombay's gymkhana is one of the best and provides room for almost all sports. There are student-run social groups.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied due to the many opportunities present in this college.
reviews.review_text: Every facility, like labs, classrooms, library, hostels, and hostel room are top Notch. Wi-Fi is everywhere. Classrooms are very Big. The hostel quality is very good and a recent hostel with very high quality infrastructure comparable to 3 star Hotel. Food quality is very good but sometimes be dependent on mess to mess of every Hostel. As sometimes the Mess Quality is degraded for Profit. The canteen provides decent quality all year round. Medical services are free for every student and there is...

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Bombay - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in this course are so good. Wi-Fi and classroom as well as a library are present in this college. The food quality in this course is so good. Medical is available and sports and games are present in this course.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent placements, world-class faculty, tough but fair academics, & campus life are hard to beat.
reviews.review_text: The academic side is honestly pretty solid. Labs are well-equipped, especially for core branches like CSE, EE, mechanical, and chemistry. We get access to good machinery software and research facilities. Classrooms are great. Library is huge 24/7, and has almost every book we need. Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus but speed drops during peak hours and can be frustrating in hostels. There is new hostel and much better than the old ones. There are big rooms, maintained mess, and games are e...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Bombay dual degree review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi facility is available. Modern classroom and world-class infrastructure. Library with an automated entry and exit system. The hostel quality was like a premium hotel. Mess and canteen food are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Four years  heavenly life.
reviews.review_text: Classroom is fully equipped with Wi-Fi and AC. The college has a central library where all kinds of books are available. The food and other facilities like gym culture room TV room everything is good. Time to time a special dinner is provided in the mess. All states' major festivals are celebrated in college.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life, and you get to work with top professors in varied domains.
reviews.review_text: While new residential buildings are coming up, the existing hostel infrastructure is a bit old, so there are some issues in that regard, and students should be mentally prepared for that. Academic infrastructure, including classrooms, labs, and a library, is at par with what students should expect from a good college.

reviews.review_heading: M.Tech experience at IIT Bombay - Placements, faculty members, and campus life.
reviews.review_text: CSE department boasted world-class facilities with 24X7 Wi-Fi, world-class labs, smart classrooms, and access to a world-class library. Hostels are hygienic with 24X7 internet, clean rooms, and housekeeping. Mess food is hygienic and good with two canteen options. Medical facilities are easily accessible. The campus boasted world-class sports grounds, gym, and recreational facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is good because of the faculty. There are good placements every year.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are very clean. We feel good to spend time there and they are very good. The quality of facilities in our hostel is good. The quality of food in the mess is delicious.

reviews.review_heading: About the dream college, IIT Bombay.
reviews.review_text: The only problem with being at IITB is that hostels were built way back in the 1960s and 1970s. Rooms were originally designed for a single student, but as time passed and the number of students increased, rooms became shared, which is somewhat comfortable. The food is adjustable. The academic infrastructure is excellent. We have Wi-Fi throughout most of the campus. Classrooms are well maintained. The library is big and has many resources. Canteens are affordable, and tasty food is served there.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it offers a fantastic package and there are no problems.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. The hostel has 24x7 electricity with a water supply. A good speed Wi-Fi is provided. The food of the canteen is very good. There are many choices for food. The food is prepared with hygiene and cleanliness.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with every corner.
reviews.review_text: IIT Bombay campus is very big. I got a hostel room for just only Rs. 15 per year and that is pretty good. Rooms in the hostel have almost 150 Mbps Wi-Fi. The food of the canteen is fantastic. There are no charges for the canteen food and sometimes there is no good food in the canteen so we can go to any other canteen on the campus. Free medical facilities and sports are provided to students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Shailesh J. Mehta School of Management, IIT BombayReviewed on 2 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college has provided decent placements in 2025 despite the bad market.
reviews.review_text: You get to experience campus life at the IIT hostel with excellent sports amenities, and medical facilities. SJMSOM has a separate building with state-of-the-art classrooms and seating facilities. Hostel food is decent enough, and you also have outlets like Chaayos and CCD giving food at subsidized prices for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in India in every field like facilities, placements, research, etc.
reviews.review_text: Top-class facilities are there at IIT Bombay in every field. Our college provides Wi-Fi in hostels, AC classrooms, AC library, many canteens, good quality food and free medical facilities, a top class sports facilities with so many grounds and courts. It even has 3 indoor volleyball courts which is very rare in India.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely the best experience of life with a green campus and the best placements.
reviews.review_text: The overall facilities in classrooms and the library are really good. All classrooms, library, and study rooms are complete equipped with AC, Wi-Fi, and LAN. Overall, hygiene is also maintained everywhere. The hostel facilities vary depending on the year we belong to. The hostel for 1st-year students is really good, with enough space in all rooms and clean. But in our 2nd and 3rd-year hostels, the infrastructure is not good, and the buildings are also old, but hygiene is still maintained. The me...

review_summary.college_name: VIT Vellore Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of VIT Vellore.

content.Placements: The current IT Batch is good with comparatively less number of students than other branches. Around 80 percent of students get placed, while others choose to go for higher education. The highest package offered in the IT branch is 53 LPA, and the lowest package offered ranges from 3-4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, but it is capped at a particular speed and shuts down at 12:30 AM. Overall, the infrastructure is good. It is equipped with gyms, basketball courts, and other sports amenities. Students have to choose the hostel and a mess every new year themselves. Hostels are allotted based on our branch rank.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Best decision of my life.

content.Placements: Placements are more than 90 percent. The internship percentage is also more than 90 percent. Top recruiting companies offering are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Visa, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in the library and every hostel block, with a pretty good internet speed. Hostel blocks are not less than heaven. There are very clean washrooms and there is no crowd in the washrooms in the morning or during peak hours, too. Food is also great, and the mess serves a variety of options to eat for students. Cybersecurity courses are offered and labs are equipped with the latest technology.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied because of the good infrastructure and good placements.

content.Placements: So, coming to the placements in BCA, the eligible CGPA for placements is above 8. If 9, it is better as about 94 percent of students get placed, as the recruiter company conducts its own exam to get into their company. The package offered ranges from 3-7 LPA for the BCA course. The college will not provide internships. We have to search for internships. The top role offered is developer.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. In VIT, all students will have the same facilities that will not differ. Our college infrastructure is a very good place to study. It will provide Wi-Fi only in the library. Hostels have their specific range, like single person per room, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 sharing rooms. The hostel fee may vary, and for 7 days, they will provide different kinds of food in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Companies hire for R&D roles.

content.Placements: Major offers for exceptional roles like research and development are provided by companies like Schlumberger, 3M, and GE Appliances, considering the invite card of our college for recruitment drives. Two kinds of packages are offered by a few companies for the top and lower roles. Some other core companies like Hitachi Energy and Intel also participate in the drives.
content.Infrastructure: Leave intimation, on-duty, and other emergencies require the intimation of the parents. Otherwise, we are not allowed anywhere. Transportation modes like the college bus and public transport such as bus, auto, and cab are available frequently. Mini stationery is available for students to purchase randomly needed things to avoid frequent movement outside the institution.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: 80% of students who got an opportunity to sit in placements are placed. Placements are decent at VIT Vellore. The package varies from 4 LPA to 1.02 CPA. It depends on the skill set of the student. Top recruiting companies include Microsoft, Google, Goldman Sachs, Benz, and many more. VIT lacks internship opportunities. The top role offered in the CSE core is a software engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very well-maintained by the VIT team. Classrooms are very well-maintained with projectors installed in every class. The labs are built with proper equipment and are loaded with ACs. Hostels are well-maintained and well-furnished. The mess food varies from hostel to hostel. VIT has excellent sports facilities, as it contains 3 gyms, 3 basketball courts, and many more facilities.

paragraphs: VIT Vellore is conducting the placement drive for the Class of 2025. As per the latest report, 868 recruiters participated during VIT Vellore placements 2025 and presented 14044 job offers to the students . The highest package offered stood at INR 1 Cr per annum . The students of the batch 2025 received 3563 super dream and 3499 dream offers from reputed companies. TCS has made the national record by offering 4004 placements to the batch 2025. The top recruiters who visited the Vellore Institute of Technology campus in 2025 include Mircosoft, Amazon, Oracle, Dell, PayPal, Cisco, Bank of America, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of VIT Vellore.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but it is capped at a particular speed and shuts down at 12:30 AM. Overall, the infrastructure is good. It is equipped with gyms, basketball courts, and other sports amenities. Students have to choose the hostel and a mess every new year themselves. Hostels are allotted based on our branch rank.

reviews.review_heading: Best decision of my life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the library and every hostel block, with a pretty good internet speed. Hostel blocks are not less than heaven. There are very clean washrooms and there is no crowd in the washrooms in the morning or during peak hours, too. Food is also great, and the mess serves a variety of options to eat for students. Cybersecurity courses are offered and labs are equipped with the latest technology.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the good infrastructure and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. In VIT, all students will have the same facilities that will not differ. Our college infrastructure is a very good place to study. It will provide Wi-Fi only in the library. Hostels have their specific range, like single person per room, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 sharing rooms. The hostel fee may vary, and for 7 days, they will provide different kinds of food in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Companies hire for R&D roles.
reviews.review_text: Leave intimation, on-duty, and other emergencies require the intimation of the parents. Otherwise, we are not allowed anywhere. Transportation modes like the college bus and public transport such as bus, auto, and cab are available frequently. Mini stationery is available for students to purchase randomly needed things to avoid frequent movement outside the institution.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very well-maintained by the VIT team. Classrooms are very well-maintained with projectors installed in every class. The labs are built with proper equipment and are loaded with ACs. Hostels are well-maintained and well-furnished. The mess food varies from hostel to hostel. VIT has excellent sports facilities, as it contains 3 gyms, 3 basketball courts, and many more facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Life at VIT Vellore is full of memories.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. Students need a good rank or a roommate with a good rank to choose better hostel blocks and rooms. Food in Vellore is not bad, and some caterers like SRRC and Darling are very good. For sports and games, there are both outdoor and indoor stadiums inside the hostel area.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with the facilities they provide, and the teachers are teaching very well.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi in the hostel, and the infrastructure is very good in VIT. The library is the best. Hostel facilities are so good, and the food is served very neatly. We have an ambulance for emergencies. We have badminton in our hostel. The hostel is very good, and the hygiene is very good. They have laundry also.

reviews.review_heading: VIT - Vellore, Tamil Nadu review.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are well furnished, and all necessary equipment like an almirah, wardrobe, table, bed, and chair are there. Classrooms are also loaded with the facilities that are required, and they keep us available as soon as possible. Food quality is impressive as they give both veg and non-veg options on the menu. Games and sports are there in bulk, most of the international player comes from this college only.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and campus life are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. I took the H Block hostel apartment type; it is costly but very spacious. Wi-Fi is good, and the food is also good. We have a health center within VIT with a medical shop, and we have a basketball court, badminton court, and all to play. The mess is also neat.

reviews.review_heading: Vellore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure was very beautiful. All blocks had good infrastructure. College only provides Wi-Fi. Labs were very helpful. In library there were all these types of books. Hostel rooms were good and also hygiene food. In total five canteens were there. Good medical and sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Vit Vellore course review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the lab and classes is good. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. In library it is available. The hostel facilities are good and the food is also good. If you're interested in sports, there is a chance you can play, and they give first preference to health in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, good ROI of CAT 1, 2, and strict rules.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good in my college. Library with many books. Wi-Fi is decent, but only in the library and hostels. There are AC and non AC rooms available, and the room you get depends on your CGPA or your roommate CGPA. Food is sometimes good, sometimes not, depending upon what mess you take. We have a volleyball, gym, a tennis table, table tennis, a basketball, a swimming pool, and a big ground for football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Well maintained campus and great environment to learn and grow.
reviews.review_text: The Computer Science department is one of the largest in VIT and hence has been provided with the best facilities, such as well equipped classrooms with smart boards and internet connection. The rooms are large and spacious. The library here is not only big but also has a wide range of books available on every topic necessary. They even have self serving kiosks, which can give us an idea of where the book is present. The hostel is well equipped, and they have good Wi-Fi, good food, AC, and non A...

reviews.review_heading: VIT University: A place that you cannot miss in your lifetime.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms are air-conditioned and smart classrooms, with projectors and speakers, and arch classrooms with rolling chairs. Every room is equipped with Wi-Fi facilities. All the hostel rooms are highly maintained, and AC and non-AC rooms are available. All the rooms in the hostel have Wi-Fi connectivity. You have different types of mess options like veg, non-veg, and special.

reviews.review_heading: Vellore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is also good and is full of greenery, which gives fresh air, and hostels are also good on our campus. Every floor contains a speed Wi-Fi network, and classrooms are clean and neat, with well-maintained food in hostel that is healthy and of good taste.

paragraphs: Each year, Vellore Institute of Technology offers scholarships in the form of tuition waivers and freeships. While merit scholarships are awarded to class toppers, economically challenged students are provided need-based financial assistance. Furthermore, NRI and foreign students are given scholarships upon presenting meritorious records. Students from rural backgrounds who secure top ranks in VITEEE at the district level (in Tamil Nadu only) are given free education.

Students who wish to pursue MTech are also given scholarships, given that they score well in the GATE exam. In addition, scholarships are given to students who excel in sports and games. Financial assistance is also provided to students who wish to do their project work in partner universities and institutions abroad, under the Semester Abroad Programme (SAP). In order to encourage the students to pursue active research, VIT also awards appropriate research associateships to meritorious and needy students.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 90 percent of students are placed in my branch. The highest was about 80 LPA and the minimum was 10-12 LPA, with an average of 20-22 LPA. individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: Amazing sports and cultural facilities, good placement, and the best place to do startups.

content.Placements: 95% get placed in the CS department. The highest package is 4 crores, the lowest is 40 LPA, and the average package is 60-70 LPA. Top recruiters are JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Jane Street, Optiver, etc. Top roles include data analyst, ML engineer, backend engineer, and frontend engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The internet is fine, some places have low connectivity, otherwise the internet is good on campus and provides good speed. Hostels are old and worn out, renovation is much needed. The library is amazing, 2 floor library, mess food is good and hygienic. Sports facilities are amazing.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production and Industrial Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities, and a lot more to explore.

content.Placements: Around 70-80 percent of the batch get placed in PIE, while roughly around 10-12 percent of the students opt for higher studies and prepare for competitive exams. The highest is around something between 50 LPA and 70 LPA, while the average is above 16 LPA, and the lowest is found to be 8 LPA. Almost every FAANG, FMCG, and other government core companies like Hindustan Oil Corporation, NBPDCL, Nestlé, Jaguar, and new startups come to recruit. Around 50 percent of the batch got the internship, and some got into top consulting firms like BCG and McKinsey. Also, some got into Microsoft, Flipkart, and Uber. Roles offered are Summer associate, AI ML engineer, SDE trainee, and Powertrain.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production and Industrial Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities and quite good alumni connections.

content.Placements: Approximately 90 percent of students are placed in my branch. The highest was about 80 LPA and the minimum was 10-12 LPA, with an average of 20-22 LPA. Many people still want to place in tech companies like Google, Microsoft, and there are also core companies like Jaguar, Tata, and many more automobile companies. About 50-60 percent are managers or team heads.
content.Infrastructure: We have classrooms that have a digital board and all the basic things. Hostels are also quite good for that price. The mess food is also good, but we get bored due to the repetitive menu. Medical and spirit facilities are also better than any other government college.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: Poor hostel conditions, but great library and teaching facilities.

content.Placements: Now even IIT Delhi's placement results are not upto the mark. Even though almost everyone applying gets a job, the packages being offered aren't satisfying. The highest packages go to around 2 crores, while the lowest can go till 10 LPA. Almost all the top companies, including Google and Microsoft, recruit from the college. Quants like Jane Street and Optiver take in applicants of second/third year for internships. They give a huge stipend for a summer internship. All sorts of roles are offered. The placement cell of IIT Delhi is OCS.
content.Infrastructure: The study infrastructure is magnificent. The lecture halls are huge, there is 24/7 Wi-Fi availability and library facilities. Whereas the quality of hostels is not good. It is really crowded as 3-4 students have to live in one room originally made for 2-3. Moreover, the building is old, so it is hard to fit in.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Environmental Engineering and Management - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: If you are passionate about this course, then join this by clearing the GATE.

content.Placements: In M.Tech, students become eligible for placement from the 3rd semester in the M.Tech programme. Accenture, Flipkart, Deloitte, etc., companies have visited the college for placement, and almost 75% students get placed. The highest package is 25 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. 75-85% students get placed in IIT New Delhi in the M.Tech programme. The companies that provide internships to students are Celebal Technology, Deloitte, TCS, Mu Sigma, etc., and a trainer internship is provided to the deserving candidates. Some companies offer a stipend, while some internships are unpaid.

paragraphs: IIT Delhi admission 2026is entrance-based for all the courses. The application forms are available on the institute's official website. The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) offers a list of courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral levels. The flagship programme of IIT Delhi is BTech which is offered in 14 different specialisations. Admission to Bachelor of Technology (BTech) is granted based on JEE Advanced followed by JoSAA counselling. Furthermore, MTech, MSc and MDes programmes are offered byIIT Delhithrough the GATE, IIT JAM, and CEED scores.
The seat allotment for BTech, MTech, and MSc courses is carried out through respective counselling bodies. Before applying to a course, the aspirant must carefully check the eligibility requirements.

Candidates applying for IIT Delhi courses must ensure that they are meeting the above-mentioned eligibility criteria. The institute has a multi-step admission process that students must follow to get into the institute. The admission procedure involves registration, entrance exam, shortlisting, release of merit list, counselling, and admission confirmation. Mentioned below in detail is how to get admission to Indian Institute of Technology Delhi:
Step 1: IIT Delhi Application Process 2026

Candidates seeking admission at IIT Delhi are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main, followed byJEE Advancedapplication.

Similarly, forIIT Delhi PG admissions, the IIT-JAM (Joint Admission Test for Masters) application form is required to be completed for the MSc course and likewise other accepted exam applications. Furthermore, apart from exam applications, candidates applying for PhD/PG courses need to apply separately on the IIT-D official website.
Step 2: IIT Delhi Selection Criteria

After the conclusion of the application process, students are required to take the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After which, counselling rounds are carried out for some of the programmes for the seat allotment process.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Candidates selected after all the selection rounds can confirm their admission/seat by paying the required amount ofIIT Delhi fee.

The various components included in theIIT Delhi feesare tuition fees, hostel fees, admission fees, caution deposits, etc. Some of the components are chargeable one-time in the total course fee. placement_data.title: IIT Delhi Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: According to the press report released by IIT Delhi, UG students of the Institute have secured 850 unique offers during the placement drive 2025. The number of unique offer this year has increased as compared with previous three years. Earlier, the number of unique offers made in 2024, 2023 and 2022 was 781, 768 and 712, respectively. The number of unique offers is expected to increase further as the IIT Delhi placement season 2025 is ongoing. Core (Technical) emerged as the top recruiting sector with placement distribution of 34% during IIT Delhi placement 2025. As per NIRF report 2025, IIT Delhi BTech placement rate in 2024 was around 83.5%. Further, IIT Delhi MBA placement rate recorded in 2024 was 100%.

At end of Phase 1 placements 2024-25, a total of 1,200 offers were made and 1,150 students were placed during the Phase 1 of IIT Delhi placements 2025. Further, more than 50 international offers were made during IIT Delhi Phase 1 placements 2024-25. Top recruiters such as BCG, Barclays, American Express, Oracle and PayU offered double-digit offers to UG students.

The median package offered during BTech placements in 2024, 2023, and 2022 were INR 19.08 LPA, INR 20 LPA, and INR 20.5 LPA , respectively. The highest and average package offered to MBA students in 2024 was INR 40.5 LPA and INR 23.4 LPA .

Core (Technical) sector emerged as the top recruiting sector that placed 34% of the total students during IIT Delhi placement 2025. It was followed by IT, Consulting and Management sectors with placement distribution of 20%, 14% and 13%, respectively.

Meanwhile, IIT Delhi alumni network is one of the most active alumni associations of the country that operates through a network of international and national chapters. The alumni association of IIT Delhi has a member strength of 6000 Graduates and is growing at about 2,000 students every year .

When compared to the ranking from the previous years, it has been seen that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuating trend. In 2024, IIT Delhi fell 1 rank to #4 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.
One can observe that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has steadiness when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2024, IIT Delhi's rank is #2, the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
The 'Management' category rankings of the institute have shown a fluctuating trend when compared to last year's rankings. In 2024, IIT Delhi climbed 1 rank to #4 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing sports and cultural facilities, good placement, and the best place to do startups.
reviews.review_text: The internet is fine, some places have low connectivity, otherwise the internet is good on campus and provides good speed. Hostels are old and worn out, renovation is much needed. The library is amazing, 2 floor library, mess food is good and hygienic. Sports facilities are amazing.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities, and a lot more to explore.
reviews.review_text: Classes in LHC have a beautiful infrastructure well-equipped with air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and silent proof. In the central library, you can find almost every book you want to read from your curriculum, as well as books that match your interests. The hostel is decent, we have a basketball court, cricket nets, a badminton court, and a TV room for cultural activities. Apart from that, I would say the mess food is average.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities and quite good alumni connections.
reviews.review_text: We have classrooms that have a digital board and all the basic things. Hostels are also quite good for that price. The mess food is also good, but we get bored due to the repetitive menu. Medical and spirit facilities are also better than any other government college.

reviews.review_heading: Poor hostel conditions, but great library and teaching facilities.
reviews.review_text: The study infrastructure is magnificent. The lecture halls are huge, there is 24/7 Wi-Fi availability and library facilities. Whereas the quality of hostels is not good. It is really crowded as 3-4 students have to live in one room originally made for 2-3. Moreover, the building is old, so it is hard to fit in.

reviews.review_heading: If you are passionate about this course, then join this by clearing the GATE.
reviews.review_text: The gym facility is available inside the campus for hostelers, the cafeteria is also there, and library facilities are also available. They are open till 6 pm every day. The hostel facility is quite affordable, but the buildings are old and in need of significant repair. The mess serves decent food. Wi-Fi all over the campus with cctv security. Classrooms are world-class, all-digital facilities available. The campus is big.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with this college. You have to secure an AIR of 1200 or below to get admission.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure in our course/department include fully air-conditioned rooms, 24-hour Wi-Fi with 250 Mbps speed. The library contains all national and international books. Labs are fully equipped with all required items. The mess and canteen food quality and quantity are very good and affordable.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty in the Civil Engineering is excellent.
reviews.review_text: The department has good labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and access to a well-equipped central library. Hostels have decent rooms, regular cleaning, and basic amenities. Mess food is average, but canteens are better. Medical facilities, sports grounds, and gyms are all reliable.

reviews.review_heading: You should choose this branch if you want to learn other subjects and aim for an IIT college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the campus. Labs and classrooms are dedicated to core textile learning and other open courses for different disciplines. The library runs throughout the year. Hostels are not well-facilitated as they were built in the 1970s. Average food, medical, sports, and games facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: The intern season is good, and the crowd is also good.
reviews.review_text: The college lecture hall complex infrastructure is good. But the hostel conditions are poor, with mediocre food in the mess and poor maintenance. Sports facilities are good throughout the campus. There are some great food outlets.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty, though placements are good.
reviews.review_text: There are enough resources available, such as high-tech labs, good lab staff, large and spacious classrooms, proper ventilation, and good maintenance. The quality of food is very poor. Nobody keeps a check on it. No proper hygiene, sanitation, or food quality checks are done.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Shiksha college submit.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in this course were so good. Wi-Fi, classroom, and labs were provided to all students for learning with practicals. The canteen food was so tasty and healthy. Medical facility was available. Sports and games were so good.

reviews.review_heading: I would say getting admitted to this college is one of the best experiences in your whole life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is always available at 10 Mb/s and it is available 24 hours. Classrooms are fully AC-furnished. Boards and projectors are available in all classrooms. Library facilities are awesome and open atleast 14 hours in normal day, and during exam time for 24 hours. All are very good.

reviews.review_heading: I am decently satisfied with the campus life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available on the campus are quite good. We have Wi-Fi all over the buildings. Almost every classroom and lab has A.C. The facilities provided to us in the hostels are also good. The mess food is decent, and we also have pretty good sports equipment.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of the quality of food and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good. It has full Wi-Fi and various labs. The quality of food is just good. The environmental engineering lab is equipped for analyzing chemical and microbiological contaminants in various media like air, water, wastewater, and soil. It houses advanced instruments such as high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), liquid chromatography time-of-flight mass spectrometry (LC-MS), and gas chromatography-mass spectrometry.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides good placements and internships.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is always on and offers high-speed data nonstop. New labs are well-maintained. Classrooms are also clean, and every room has AC, light, a projector, etc. Medical facilities are free of cost. Mess food is average. Many hostels have night canteens, and they offer tasty food. Sports complexes are well-maintained and spacious for students to play in.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of facilities and life at IIT Madras.

content.Placements: My batch has 154 students, which makes it the second-largest branch on the campus. The highest package offered is 1.31 crores per annum. The top recruiting companies for our course are Google, Microsoft, etc. A lot of other renowned companies around the world also visit the college. The top roles offered are software development engineer, validation engineer, IC design, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The department building is very spacious with a lot of classrooms and labs. The building is a bit old, so the renovation is being made now. The hostel infrastructure is nice, but there is a bit of a problem with monkeys in one or two of them. The mess food is of nice quality. Food courts are available throughout the day.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good campus, good placement, good faculty, but hostel alone needs improvement.

content.Placements: Placements are good and decent, we will receive top recruits. Core options are more. Package offered is decent with respect to our CGP it lies. Getting an internship is a difficult part but getting placed is easy. Nearly 80% of students get placed in a year. But you should maintain decent grades and skills.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel infrastructure needs to be improved. We will receive free Wi-Fi throughout. Library and many places are provided for students to study. We have wide options for mess and menu. Canteens are available at low cost without compromising the food quality. Labs are awesome.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering + M.Tech. in Applied Mechanics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Great campus life with good placements and strong academic support.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students got placed. The highest package was 18 LPA, the lowest 5 LPA, average salary was 9 LPA. Top companies like L&T, ISRO, and DRDO. 60% of students got internships in same companies. Roles offered were design engineer, research associate, and tech consultant. It's quite good here.
content.Infrastructure: Department had good labs, classrooms with AC and projector, and Wi-Fi all around. Library was big with many books. Hostel rooms were fine, and shared type. Mess food was okay, sometimes good, sometimes not. Medical help was available 24X7. Many sports ground and gym were also there. It's quite good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The best campus in India, and very good.

content.Placements: Around 80% of people go for higher studies in India and abroad. The highest package offer is 42LPA, and the lowest is around 6 to 7LPA. Top recruiters included TCS, Wipro, L&T, and Accenture. 60% of people got internships in many companies.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities in the department and library include Wi-Fi. Everything is good and well. The hostel is maintained well and nicely, with a mess, food, good infrastructure, AC classrooms, and facilitated labs. Medical facilities and sports facilities are also good.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall best college for M.A. In Economics Course.

content.Placements: Placements are excellent for our department. Students of finance are assigned to companies related to finance. The typical salary varies between approximately 15-25 LPA. PSUs visit our college for hiring purposes as well. The top packages reach as much as 3 LPA. Approximately 71-76% of students secure placements annually. 59% of learners obtained internships.
content.Infrastructure: The college is located in the northeast, and connectivity to the rest of India is limited. Thus, there were few female students on campus. Hotels were good. Each student is given an individual furnished room. Each hotel has a mess area, restaurant, and TV room. The food is awesome. It will take some time to adjust the menu for other public school students.

paragraphs: Indian Institute of Technology Madrasalso known asIITMoffers the programmes through regular and full-time modes. Students are offered over ten programmes spanning multiple specialisations.IIT Madras admission processincludes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list and counselling. Students must meet the eligibility and selection criteria prior to applying for the desired course. The process mainly commences online. The step-wise admission process forIIT Madras UG & PG coursesis given below:
IIT Madras Application 2026

Candidates seeking admission must complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For example, for BTech, candidates are required to apply for JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced application.

Similarly, for the MSc, IIT JAM application form is required to be completed. However, for MTech admission, candidates have to register for GATE first. The qualifying candidates have further applied for COAP and then applied on the official website of IIT Madras to proceed to confirm their admission.
Selection Rounds 2026

For BTech courses, students are selected based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced entrance scores. However, for MTech course, students must have GATE entrance exam scores followed by COAP Counselling. The institute considers IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling for MSc courses. Candidates can check with the admission office for the selection rounds of the rest of the courses.
Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. For merit-based courses, the institute will release a course-wise merit list on the official website. Shortlisted candidates and then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

IIT Madras fee structureincludes tuition fees, library fees, laboratory fees, caution deposit, and more. Some of these charged only once during the admission. The rest are to be paid either semester-wise or yearly as per the institute's guidelines. faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIT Madras?
faqs.answer: To seek admission to the BTech programme offered at IIT Madras, candidates need to visit the official website of the National Testing Agency (NTA) and fill out the application form in online mode for JEE Main. For other courses such as MSc, MTech, BS-MS (Dual Degree) etc., candidates must visit the official website of the respective national-level entrance exam conducting bodies and fill out the application form in online mode. IIT Madras admission to most of the courses is entrance-based.

faqs.question: Is COAP mandatory for IIT Madras admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, COAP registration is mandatory for IIT Madras admissions done on the basis of GATE exam. The institute accepts GATE + COAP for both M.Tech and MA admissions. Any student choosing to register via GATE score at the institute must register on COAP portal as well.

faqs.question: Is JEE exam mandatory for BSc at IIT Madras?
faqs.answer: No, JEE exams are not mandatory for BSc admissions at IIT Madras. Candidates who wish to take admissions into the BSc course at IIT Madras must appear for IISER entrance examination. The admissions into IIT Madras BSc courses are decided on merit basis where, the scores obtained by candidates in the IISER entrance exam are taken into account to decide the admissions.

placement_data.title: IIT Madras Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: IIT Madras Consolidated Placement Report 2025 is released on the official website. The report published has department-wise salary package details. For BTech departments such as EE, CS and CH , the average package recorded was 28.8 LPA, 53.2 LPA, 18.8 LPA.
For Dual degree departments such as ME, CH and ED, the median package this year was 22.2 LPA, 24.5 LPA and 21.7 LPA.

The overall highest, average and median package recorded during IIT Madras MBA placements 2025 was 35.5 LPA, 17.9 LPA and 18 LPA . In Tech MBA , highest and average package received in 2025 was 81 LPA and 20 LPA .

MTech placement 2025 was also better with average and median package recorded for CS department being 29 LPA and 24.6 LPA. Other than this, the average and median package during MS placement 2025 for CS department was 21.9 LPA and 22.2 LPA.
The median package recorded during the placement drive 2025 for MSc Chemistry and Physics courses was 7.2 LPA and 12 LPA. For MA Humanities course, the average and median package was 17.2 LPA.

nirf.description:
IIT Madras has received strong ranks by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the NIRF 2025. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Madras's rank is #1, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
One can observe that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has steadiness when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, IIT Madras's rank is #1, the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Management' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, IIT Madras climbed 3 ranks to #13 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.
It is noticeable that in the 'Research Institutions' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability in trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, IIT Madras's rank is #2, the same as last year's rank in the 'Research Institutions' category by the NIRF ranking.

qs_world.description:
IIT Madras has received strong ranks by the QS World University Rankings under the 'Top Global Universities' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the QS World University Rankings 2026. In the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, IIT Madras climbed 47 ranks to #180 rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.

reviews.review_heading: Review of facilities and life at IIT Madras.
reviews.review_text: The department building is very spacious with a lot of classrooms and labs. The building is a bit old, so the renovation is being made now. The hostel infrastructure is nice, but there is a bit of a problem with monkeys in one or two of them. The mess food is of nice quality. Food courts are available throughout the day.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus, good placement, good faculty, but hostel alone needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure needs to be improved. We will receive free Wi-Fi throughout. Library and many places are provided for students to study. We have wide options for mess and menu. Canteens are available at low cost without compromising the food quality. Labs are awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life with good placements and strong academic support.
reviews.review_text: Department had good labs, classrooms with AC and projector, and Wi-Fi all around. Library was big with many books. Hostel rooms were fine, and shared type. Mess food was okay, sometimes good, sometimes not. Medical help was available 24X7. Many sports ground and gym were also there. It's quite good.

reviews.review_heading: The best campus in India, and very good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the department and library include Wi-Fi. Everything is good and well. The hostel is maintained well and nicely, with a mess, food, good infrastructure, AC classrooms, and facilitated labs. Medical facilities and sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall best college for M.A. In Economics Course.
reviews.review_text: The college is located in the northeast, and connectivity to the rest of India is limited. Thus, there were few female students on campus. Hotels were good. Each student is given an individual furnished room. Each hotel has a mess area, restaurant, and TV room. The food is awesome. It will take some time to adjust the menu for other public school students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely beautiful campus with wildlife.
reviews.review_text: Courses in my branch are difficult; others are pretty okay. Infrastructure depends on the branch you are in. Aerospace has a very mediocre infrastructure. Coming to the hostel, it is okay. I can't describe it as good exactly. Food is edible, extra in the mess would be good, food courts have good food. Medical facilities are good, and they have good sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Life at IITM is like your dream college life.
reviews.review_text: Institute Wi-Fi is present in all public places. Labs and classrooms are very well maintained and mostly air-conditioned. Library is open from 8:00 AM to 11:30 PM, and it is air-conditioned too. Hostel facilities are moderate, and we come to the hostel mostly for sleeping. We stay in the library most of the time. The quality of food available is also moderate. The institute hospital is very good, like a multi-specialty hospital. All types of sports are played here like cricket, football, badmint...

reviews.review_heading: A must experience campus life.
reviews.review_text: All the infrastructure in our department is top-notch, with table Wi-Fi connections, AC classrooms, and lab facilities for various subjects. All the students will be provided with hostels at the time of admission. There are single, double, triple, and quadruple sharing rooms. In each room, a cot, a cupboard, a study table with a chair, a socket, and LAN facilities will be provided. Hostels also have a basketball court, lawns, and various games, including board games. Mess can be selected by the ...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure of hostel is too good and neat and clean. There will be a single room also available in the hostel. Classroom is near and good. 
Labs with all facilities. Library has been quiet and peaceful. Canteen facilities are super on campus and worth money.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, but you need to read and enjoy as well.
reviews.review_text: IIT Madras has good classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, nice labs, and a big library. Hostels are clean with 24-hour water, power, and internet. Mess food is clean and okay, with different food choices. Canteens have many tasty options. There is a free campus hospital and ambulance. Sports grounds, gym, and games are also available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Best college with best placement rates.
reviews.review_text: Best infrastructure I have ever seen in my whole life. Every type of facility is available to students. IITM will give you everything, you just have to study and enjoy on campus. First time you enter the campus, you will find yourself in jungle.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, best college for MS in electrical engineering course.
reviews.review_text: In our college, classrooms were very primitive but labs had all the latest equipment for students from IIT to do their research. The quality of mess food varies greatly depending on where you come from. North Indians find it difficult to change their diet. Hostel furniture was quite outdated. Washing machines were exceptional, and western toilets were never expected.

reviews.review_heading: Life at IITM was lit from 2022 - 2026.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in every hostel. Labs are up to date in equipments and technology. Classrooms are okay, some are without ACs so it gets hot. Mess food is okay in quality. Sports facilities are abundant, and you can play your favourite sport. There is a hospital on campus which is sufficient for mild diseases.

reviews.review_heading: Read this before enrolling in IIT Madras BS degree in data science and application.
reviews.review_text: IIT Madras BS degree in data science and application is an online program that you can study from any location (also from abroad). All course is published prerecorded on the website of IIT Madras. There is a live doubt-solving lecture on Google Meet or Zoom. It is an online program so there is no need to go, it has campus in Madras but the exams are conducted offline. There are various centers for the exam also in other countries. Its fees are affiliated, also there is a scholarship upto 75%. Th...

reviews.review_heading: Very beautiful and calm, has very good faculty, and has all you need,
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch. The hostels could be improved but value for money, the facilities of all the grounds are good and well maintained, has a lot apart from academics, the library is big and has a lot of things, Wi-Fi has some problems now and then but in general it is good enough, quality of food depends on the mess we choose.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated M.Sc. (Hons.) in Mathematics - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: It provides freedom to explore personal interests.

content.Placements: Placements of BITS Hyderabad are very good at around 91% and throughout the years, it has also seen a constant rise. Overall Average CTC for BITS Hyderabad is around 20LPA. Top recruiters include Atlassian, Dell, Google, Microsoft, Deloitte, Oracle, Adobe, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels at BITS are clean and spacious. Each hostel also includes common rooms with indoor games like air hockey and table tennis, and outside courts for badminton and volleyball. Mess food is a well-balanced meal and made in hygienic places. The medical centre is open 24/7, and also ambulances come to the hostel gate in case of emergency. Courts and other playing facilities are well-maintained for every sport.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Worth the high fees due to ROI, but after entering, hard work is expected to excel.

content.Placements: The percentage placement is high, due to the brand name as well as quality of students. More than 80% of batch was planned with highly reputed companies with high packages in fields of tech, finance, and core came to hire, eg, Google, BlackRock, Nvidia, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Entire campus is Wi-Fi covered, and classrooms are well maintained with blocks assigned to departments like mechanical, CS, and electrical. Library is also pretty big, with a capacity of 600+, and it has a great interior, and provides a peaceful vibe for studying. Quality of hostel and mess is also good, food taste is decent with a different menu.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure, environment, facilities, and placement prospects.

content.Placements: The better part is that over 80% of students find placements. The lowest salary would be around 8 LPA, while the highest could exceed 40 LPA, with the average being 12 LPA. Top recruiters include Mercedes, L&T, and BHEL from the mechanical stream, and students can also choose to pursue non-teaching roles, which many do. As mentioned above, the top roles include analyst, management, and R&D.
content.Infrastructure: Ethernet connectivity is available in hostel rooms and the library (1 Gbps speed), with Wi-Fi throughout the hostel and academic block, and in the library (100 Mbps). The food can be considered fair, with the menu undergoing slight changes every two months. For the mechanical department, we have dedicated labs, workshops, and sandbox areas.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa Campus.

content.Placements: More than 80% of students got placed. A lot of companies recruit students, including Microsoft, Google, Rubric, Dell, Deloitte, Oracle, Adobe, Nestle, etc. Top roles include software developer, analyst, app developer, product management, etc. The median package is 17 LPA. Core branches like electrical have an average salary of 18 LPA - 20 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The facility is very good. The academic block is beautiful, consisting of 4 lecture theatres and a lot of classrooms. Some labs are also present. A big canteen includes a kitchen and a Nescafe shop. There is also a big auditorium in the basement. There is a football and cricket ground with floodlights. Other sports facilities are also available. Hostels of the new block are very good with fully furnished rooms and 2 common washrooms on each floor. The campus is beautiful and green.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The overall experience with college is really good and I will definitely recommend it to others.

placement_data.title: BITS Pilani Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: BITS Pilani has released the placement details for the Class of 2025. According to the media report, BITS Pilani has achieved 54.35% placements in the semestor 1 of the placement session 2025 across its three Indian campuses (Pilani, Goa, Hyderabad). A total of 1700 students registered for the placements, of which 924 secured job offers from reputed companies. The average salary offered across the three campuses stood at INR 28.64 LPA . The average package secured by the students of the BITS Pilani batch 2025 was INR 31.63 LPA. The top recruiters of BITS Pilani in 2025 include Accenture, EY, IBM, General Electric, Volvo Eicher, etc.

According to the official record, the highest and average packages offered to the MBA BA students during BITS Pilani placements 2025 was INR 26 LPA and INR 16.57 LPA. T he median package secured by the MBA batch 2025 was INR 18 LPA .
Earlier, BITS Pilani achieved a placement rate of 82.75% for First Degree (FD) and 73.61% placements for Higher Degree (HD) courses for 2023-2024.
