review_summary.college_name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Lovely days at my college.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed is very vague, as a lot of students opt out of placements because of their CGPA, and they are not considered for placement. If you are an average student, you can get around 6 to 7 LPA if you maintain your CGPA. Companies like Wipro and L&T are the top recruiters. For internships, you have to secure them yourself, as the college gives almost zero support.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and classrooms are actually pretty good if you opt for CSE, as the new building TP 2 is highly advanced. The library is also pretty good, with a nighttime study facility. Hostels are expensive, and the hostel staff is pretty annoying. You have an appointment at 9 o’clock, so beware of that.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best and excellent college.

content.Placements: 70 percent of students got internship. 85 percent of students got placed. The top recruiting companies are Accenture, Google, and Microsoft. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA. The top roles are project manager and software developer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good in our college. The classrooms are neat and clean with comfortable benches. The washrooms are neat and clean. The labs are good. The books are available in the library. We have good Wi-Fi connection. The hostel facilities are good, and canteen is also available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (BOT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My college is asia number one of tamilnadu.

content.Placements: 90 above and average package and recruitment process and global and IT value to improve ourselves and prepare for the course. The package level is based on experience and knowledge, companies only give higher level monthly salaries to those who are capable of working in the company. Many companies are offered in my college.
content.Infrastructure: Food is available in the hostel and is strictly maintained. Students have fixed discipline and are given time for breaks in the main canteen. There are many canteens in the college for food, and temples are also present on the campus, as it is a big college in Tamil Nadu SRM campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: About good and enjoyable college.

content.Placements: From 7th semester, students become eligible for campus placements. Top companies are Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HUL, HCL, and so on. I got an offer in 2 companies, Infosys and Base Automation Technologies. The highest package is 51 LPA, and the average package is 3 LPA to 5 LPA. 90% of people are easily getting placed, and have plans after getting the placements to work.
content.Infrastructure: The main thing I would like to mention here is library, over 4 lakhs books are placed in the library including IAS, IFS, IPS, central and state government aspirants can also use it. The gym is overall good. Campus timing is 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, depending on the day of the order and departments. Security is very strict here so students can't do any unnecessary activities inside the campus.

hostel_campus.college_name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: SRM University has 14 blocks for boys and 7 blocks for girls. All the hostels have hi speed Wi-Fi connectivity and are provided with solar water have heating systems, mineral water supply, water cooler in each floor, generator power supply.Students are offered with healthy and sumptuous food options at highly subsidized rates and can choose to have North Indian or South Indian menu in the dining halls that are co-located. the hostels also offer a multi-cuisine dining facility providing Thai, Chinese and continental food for the benefit of our international students,.Rooms with single cot ,study table & chair, cupboard & common mirror are available. Most hostels have common washrooms, a few blocks are available with attached bath and AC rooms too. Facilities such as gym, prayer halls, games, sports and cultural activities has been facilitated. 3 International hostels with modernized kitchen,library,drinking water, water heater, telephone,power supply, medical care, recreation,stationery shop, laundry point, gym, playground, indoor games, banking facility, a/c dining hall, a/c study hall and one off campus international hostel is also available.
facilities: College Infrastructure: SRM has a well-defined layout in terms of infrastructure. The campus is spread over a large area, with all the basic facilities provided. There are huge grounds and indoor courts for sports; the gymnasium is made for the students of the college. The library is technically advanced and has a good collection of books. The classrooms are well maintained with smart boards installed, and the washrooms are clean. The canteen has diverse varieties of food that are hygienic and affordable.

Academics: CSE has proven to be a good course for me as it aligns with my interests and liking for computers and programming. The course is well updated, and even the curricula followed in college fall in line with the skills required in the job sector. The course has a lot of research and practicality, which definitely makes one job-ready. The teachers are cooperative and experienced, and they mentor each student at every point.

Placements: Approximately 70% of the students get hired in the recruitment drive held by the college. The placement drive is held in the most efficient manner. The average package is around 5 LPA, which is a good kickstart for any student in their respective fields. The college has a placement cell that is responsible for inviting firms to the college and guiding fellow students in getting placed, hence making the college supportive. The placements must be inclusive of all the courses, which is a demerit.

Value-for-money: The annual tuition fee structure was a bit on the expensive side, as my yearly fee was around 3 lacs p/a, which might not be affordable for many students. But the quality of services and education, with all the basic amenities, make SRM worth the investment. Personally, SRM is making each penny count.

Campus Life: Though the college is isolated from the main part of the city, it is glorious from the inside. There are sports activities in the college and many cultural societies, like dance and music societies. Moreover, there are various clubs that keep on participating in educational competitions. Various seminars are held and several festivals are conducted throughout the year, making college life happen. There's a medical room to handle any emergency as and when it arises!

IIT Kharagpur popular programmes are BTech & MTech. After doing BTech from IIT Kharagpur West Bengal, students can become Computer Science Engineers, Civil Engineers, Ceramic Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Production Engineers, & others. BTech is the flagship programmes in IIT Kharagpur. Recently IIT kharagpur announced that they are going to conduct a workshop on Accelerated Computing for AI-ML and has also launched the Jyoti Chatterjee School of Digital Engineering, Applied AI and ML.
Some of the top companies such as Amazon, Barclays, KPMG, & others recruit MTech students during IIT placements. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology and Biochemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A land of opportunities where legacy meets innovation.

content.Placements: In Biotechnology almost 70 percent of students got placed. The average package is 6 LPA, the highest is near 12 LPA, the lowest normally differs. Serum Institute of India and Cipla do hire at IITKGP. More than 12 percent of students got an internships. Roles offered are Junior Researcher, Research Associate, and Bioprocess Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The department being one of the most heavily funded and having state-of-the-art technology in the labs students get to work with reliable and modern instruments and labs. The infrastructure offered for the students in the course of biotechnology is very good and one of the best in the country. The quality of food in hostels is fine not too good not dreadful either. The medical facilities are free for students. There are a lot of grounds for each sport and all the sports and games are taught as part of the course that comes under extra academic activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology and Biochemical Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: If you want to go ahead with your dream, then it's your best college.

content.Placements: 100 percent of students got placed in our course. The highest placement package was 78 LPA, and the lowest was 5 LPA. There were top-level recruiting companies like Bajaj, ISRO, Tata, Apple, and many more. 100 percent of students got internships here. The top roles offered from here were assistant manager, product manager, and CEO.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi was present everywhere. Fully furnished labs, digital classrooms, and a central library were present on the college campus itself. Hostels were of top quality with AC rooms, speed Wi-Fi, clean and green campus, fully styled rooms, and a digital movie theatre.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The best part of my life is spent here at IIT Kharagpur.

content.Placements: In this college, they are providing the best salary packages, and every year, a total of 40 percent of students are placed in these companies. In this college, there are many companies providing internships because it is the very best college in India. The top recruiters are TCS, Accenture, Tata Group, etc.
content.Infrastructure: This college's infrastructure and quality of things are very high and provide many facilities to the students. In this course, facilities are available like fast Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, fans, bathrooms, branches, hostels, canteens, etc. In this college, the canteen food is very tasty; it is like homemade food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Mother of all IITs - IIT Kharagpur.

content.Placements: During the current placement, there were 1000+ offers in just two days. In my department, Mechanical Engineering, about 70% of students get placed. The average placement package is 17-18 LPA, the highest going upto 50-55 LPA. If we talk about the maximum package offered, it sometimes crosses 2 crores.
content.Infrastructure: State-of-the-art infrastructure is present for all the students. Labs, classes and libraries are best. The hostels can be a little disappointing, the food there is not that good, and it will take time to adjust to the taste of the mess food. But you can always find night canteens and restaurants inside the campus if you want to treat yourself to good food.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. (Hons.) + M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Its the top college in India, you have to qualify for this.

content.Placements: The placements in IITKP are very good, as a lot of companies visit due to the placements. The B.Tech students are available to sit for placements in their 4th year, while the dual degree students are available to sit for placements in their 5th year. In my course, the highest package in general lies around 1.5 crores per annum, and the lowest package lies around 10 to 20 LPA. There are five profiles that students choose during placements. The software development is the one I am choosing, and the companies offer, on average, around 20LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities in IITKGP are not up to the mark. The hostels are mostly run based on Hall tempo and bonding. The library here is also one of the biggest libraries of all the IITs, and it has a lot of rooms where you can sit and study. It stays open till 12 o'clock. Almost all of the books are available in the library that you want to read, or it has access to the national digital library, and you can read anything that you want. The facilities of technological aspects are also really good.

faqs.question: Which is the best branch at IIT Kharagpur? Are the placements better than other similarly ranked IITs?
faqs.answer: IIT Kharagpur, IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati are three similarly-ranked Engineering institutes in India that are closely ranked by the NIRF Ranking Institution. Needless to say, these institutes have outstanding academic and placement achievements. Students look for informed decisions while choosing between the three. In NIRF Engineering ranking 2025 , IIT Kharagpur stands at 5th position, whereas, IIT Guwahati and IIT Hyderabad are ranked at 8th and 7th position, respectively . Thus, indicating a close competition between the three. IIT Kharagpur outshines IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati for having the largest campus area and being the oldest IIT. IIT Kharagpur came into existence in 1951, whereas, IIT Guwahati and IIT Hyderabad were established in 1994 and 2008, respectively. Comparing the institutes on academic grounds, IIT Kharagpur (108) offers a larger number of full-time courses than IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati. In terms of placements, IIT Guwahati has released the overall statistics for BTech. IIT Kharagpur wins the race with the highest package of INR 2.40 crore per annum. The second slot is taken by IIT Guwahati with the highest package of INR 1.20 crore per annum. Then comes, IIT Hyderabad highest package of INR 90 LPA. The table below represents the IIT Kharagpur highest package comparison with other closely ranked IITs for the BTech placements: IIT Name BTech (Highest Package) IIT Kharagpur INR 2.40 crore per annum IIT Guwahati - INR 1.20 crore per annum (domestic) - INR 72 LPA (international) IIT Hyderabad INR 90 LPA Students looking for more elaborated branch-wise placement information can read the below section comparing IIT Kharagpur and IIT Hyderabad. The highest package grabbed by the CE batch 2022 during the IIT Kharagpur phase-I placements was INR 55 LPA. The IIT Hyderabad CE highest package was very close and stood at INR 52 LPA. For other branches, such as CH, CS, EE, and ME, IIT Kharagpur beats IIT Hyderabad in terms of the highest package

reviews.review_heading: A land of opportunities where legacy meets innovation.
reviews.review_text: The department being one of the most heavily funded and having state-of-the-art technology in the labs students get to work with reliable and modern instruments and labs. The infrastructure offered for the students in the course of biotechnology is very good and one of the best in the country. The quality of food in hostels is fine not too good not dreadful either. The medical facilities are free for students. There are a lot of grounds for each sport and all the sports and games are taught as p...

reviews.review_heading: If you want to go ahead with your dream, then it's your best college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was present everywhere. Fully furnished labs, digital classrooms, and a central library were present on the college campus itself. Hostels were of top quality with AC rooms, speed Wi-Fi, clean and green campus, fully styled rooms, and a digital movie theatre.

reviews.review_heading: The best part of my life is spent here at IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: This college's infrastructure and quality of things are very high and provide many facilities to the students. In this course, facilities are available like fast Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, fans, bathrooms, branches, hostels, canteens, etc. In this college, the canteen food is very tasty; it is like homemade food.

reviews.review_heading: Mother of all IITs - IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: State-of-the-art infrastructure is present for all the students. Labs, classes and libraries are best. The hostels can be a little disappointing, the food there is not that good, and it will take time to adjust to the taste of the mess food. But you can always find night canteens and restaurants inside the campus if you want to treat yourself to good food.

reviews.review_heading: Its the top college in India, you have to qualify for this.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities in IITKGP are not up to the mark. The hostels are mostly run based on Hall tempo and bonding. The library here is also one of the biggest libraries of all the IITs, and it has a lot of rooms where you can sit and study. It stays open till 12 o'clock. Almost all of the books are available in the library that you want to read, or it has access to the national digital library, and you can read anything that you want. The facilities of technological aspects are also really good...

reviews.review_heading: An engineering life at IIT Kharagpur is very joyful and good.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are available in our college. Wi-Fi is very good and useful for our academic career. High-speed Wi-Fi is also available at our central library. Hostel facilities are available and comfortable. Hostel food is satisfactory, but it is not good. There are good games to play, like cricket, carrom, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of IIT Kharagpur is very good, as it has high-speed Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi), and it also has many labs that are very good and well-maintained by the college. The mess food is also very good and hygienic, and the hostels are also well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur.
reviews.review_text: The IIT Kharagpur infrastructure is old, but it's clean and filled with greenery. All facilities are available in our college, with full speed of Wi-Fi, all resources are available in our college, with full security, and the hostel rooms are clean, and the hostel food is tasty and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Top student in India to get into this college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was world class. This was the best campus in all of India. Classrooms were made fully furnished by the British Empire. All facilities were available in the classrooms. Library is like a university campus, with all types of books in the world available. There are gardens, a swimming pool, different grounds for different sports and many extracurricular activities present. Hostels are very good. Mess food is very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a big place where you can definitely find someone with the same vibe as you.
reviews.review_text:
The Wi-Fi connection is smooth and good, and is available through the hostel's classroom library and even the auditoriums. 
It has one of the biggest libraries, but some books are not so well-maintained. 
The quality of food is enough to survive in terms of taste, but it is also nutritious for the body.
There is a hospital on the campus, which is open 24/7
We have a court for basketball, volleyball and badminton in every respective hall, with the seniors allowing anyone interested to play to go ...

reviews.review_heading: Everything is excellent, only sometimes the infrastructure may seem to be old.
reviews.review_text: The academic section is excellent. Wi-Fi (avg speed 200mbps) is available throughout the whole campus. Hostels are not up to date. In the first year, you will get a triple-sharing room. From the second year, you may get a triple sharing or a single room, depending on the hostel you are allotted. From the third year onwards, you are allotted single rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements but bad gender ratio.
reviews.review_text: There are around 21 hostels in the institute, approximately 16 hostels for boys and 5 for girls. I live in Nehru Hall. This is one of the oldest hostels in IIT Kharagpur. Sundar Pichai also stayed here. There are facilities like Wi-Fi, cooler, geyser, LAN connection, etc. The mess food quality is average, as in most of the hostels. They serve food 4 times a day, 2 heavy meals and 2 light meals. Hostel and mess fees are usually around Rs. 40,000 per semester. There are also gyms, basketball court...

reviews.review_heading: We have the best campus and the largest of all the IITs. Teachers and placements are good.
reviews.review_text: 24/7 Wi-Fi is available with good speed. The Department building is huge, and advanced machinery and devices are present in the lab. There is a Nescafe just outside the department for refreshment, and there is a personal departmental library for the Biotech students.

reviews.review_heading: Great place with decent perks.
reviews.review_text: There is a decent infrastructure and a great place to learn. The library is one of the best of its kind. Hostels are the things that could be better in some way or another. Hostel life is, in another way, mostly beautiful with our people around, and food quality is also good. Need to adjust sometimes.

reviews.review_heading: Perfect regarding semester exams and good regarding infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. But it works slowly in certain places. Labs are good for understanding your interest in the subject. All the equipment present in the lab is also working in good condition. Our classroom complex is named Nalanda, which is very good-looking, and the classrooms are also very good with an AC supply. Medical facilities are free on our campus. Doctors are also good. But it will not be open all the time. If you want to meet the doctor for an emergency situatio...

reviews_list.review_title: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.

review_content.Placements: The percentage of placements in our course is really nice, it is more than (94)%. Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Micron, Synapse, Google, Amazon, Oracle, TCS, Wipro, Bajaj, etc. (These are mixed companies for electronics, software, and electrical). Chip designer, electro manager, developed (to be honest, I don't know much about the role they offer). The highest and lowest salary is average.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quality is good). But North-Indians may not like the taste initially.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.

review_content.Placements: Now I am a fresher here. If we look at the placements at NIT Trichy, they are amazing. To be honest, I am from the Civil Engineering branch, so we cannot expect high packages, but our seniors get into many PSUs. The alumni here help the most with placements. Last year, nearly 78% of students were placed in my course. The highest package is 34 LPA and 20 LPA for core jobs.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

overview_faqs.question: How is the MCA programme at NIT, Trichy?
overview_faqs.answer: At the postgraduate level, NIT Trichy provides two-year MTech, MBA, MCA, and various other courses to students. The MCA program at NIT, Trichy is good. NIT Tiruchirappalli is ranked 701-710 by QS World University Rankings 2025. It is one of the top-ranked universities present in India. MCA students get great placement opportunities in top companies like Google, Infosys, Facebook, Oracle, and others. The university infrastructure is also very good. overview_faqs.question: How is life at NIT Trichy?
overview_faqs.answer: The alumni feedback for NIT Trichy shows several facts about the life that the students experience. The points below show several such facts: 1. The institute campus is located in an isolated location away from the main city.2. The lecture halls are decent and well-ventilated. The professors are pretty helpful in your academic life. 3. There are Student Activity Centers, Multi-utility Halls, and an Open-Air Theater, which give students an opportunity for extra-curricular activities.4. Additionally, there is a sports complex and playgrounds to encourage sports culture. 5. Many academic blocks have air-conditioning facilities, particularly computer labs. 6. There is a four-floored central library with more than 1.5 Lacs books and is a good place for readers. 7. There are many clubs, such as tech clubs. Some of the most popular are the RMI Club for robotics, the Spider Club for electronics and coding, and DC for design.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Trichy Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure, but a bad climate in the summer. There are exceptional peers.

content.Placements: I'm not sure about the percentage of students who got internships or placements. I suggest that students just check it out on the college website. It is legitimate. But to be frank, the packages offered in core, as I know, in production are very few. But this branch is special in offering the connection between management and technical fields. Excellent packages and placements are available in non-core fields, especially consulting and management. The branch is a chill one, which offers ample time for studying anything or extracurricular activities.
content.Infrastructure: The library facility, octagon, or if I say anything in the college, is just on a different level, except for hostels. Being a college affiliated with NIRF 9, we expect much better from their side in hostel management. There is no responsibility on their part if a theft happens. Actually, two laptops were stolen. The library must have a proper internet connection, which is bad. The hostel is improving right now with proper renovation after our complaints. It serves very good mess food. I'll say much better than any college. Since I've been in some.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has one of the best placement records. Classes are a bit hectic, but overall, it's good.

content.Placements: There is an 80 percent placement rate in B.Tech civil engineering. The lowest package offered is 3 LPA, and the highest package offered is 33 LPA. For tech fields, companies like Microsoft and Google, and for core companies like Dalmia, ACC Cement, L&T, etc., hire students. Internships are not very common in this branch, so we have to fight a bit more compared to other branches.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and mess facilities are among the best across all NITs and IITs. We have high-speed Wi-Fi in each room. The mess food is great compared to other top colleges. There is a curfew for first-year boys. For girls, it is for all four years. We have an NIT Hospital for medical issues or emergencies. NIT Trichy has one of the top sports infrastructures.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.

content.Placements: The percentage of placements in our course is really nice, it is more than (94)%. Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, Micron, Synapse, Google, Amazon, Oracle, TCS, Wipro, Bajaj, etc. (These are mixed companies for electronics, software, and electrical). Chip designer, electro manager, developed (to be honest, I don't know much about the role they offer). The highest and lowest salary is average.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quality is good). But North-Indians may not like the taste initially.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.

content.Placements: Now I am a fresher here. If we look at the placements at NIT Trichy, they are amazing. To be honest, I am from the Civil Engineering branch, so we cannot expect high packages, but our seniors get into many PSUs. The alumni here help the most with placements. Last year, nearly 78% of students were placed in my course. The highest package is 34 LPA and 20 LPA for core jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The institute offers strong academics and campus life, with scope for better industry exposure.

content.Placements: CSE / IT placements are around 95–100%, while the overall placement percentage at NIT Trichy is above 90%. The highest package offered is 45–55 LPA from international and top product companies, the average package is 25–30 LPA, and the lowest package is 6–8 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, and the major roles offered are Software Development Engineer (SDE), Backend / Full-Stack Developer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, and AI Engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The campus provides 24×7 high-speed Wi-Fi across academic blocks and hostels. Laboratories consist of computer labs with high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. They are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and audio systems.

faqs.question: Is JEE Main required for NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: Admissions to NIT (National Institute of Technology), Trichy is Entrance Based for almost all of the courses. The college accepts different exam scores for different levels of courses. Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Mains is necessary for admissions to the undergraduate engineering programs, B.Tech which offers 8 courses and B.Arch which offers 1 course. Admissions are based on the marks scored in class 12thor equivalent as well as the JEE (Main) examination. Seats are allocated to students through Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA), Central Seat Allocation Board (CSAB) and the Direct Admission of Students Abroad (DASA).

faqs.question: Are NIT Trichy admissions 2024 open for BTech course?
faqs.answer: NIT Trrichy admission process begin with the JEE Main registration. The admission process 2023 via JEE Main has been completed, whereas the regisrations for the year 2024 will start in the month of Decemeber. The exam is likely to be conducted in the month of January,  2024. Candidates can visit the official website of NTA to apply for the course.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: For direct admission information at NIT Trichy, students must visit the official website and ask for this information. Candidates willing to take part in the NIT Trichy course admissions process must apply before the last date of application. Candidates must know their NIT Trichy eligibility criteria and apply accordingly. Follow the NIT Trichy application process mentioned below:Step 1:Visit the official website of the NIT Trichy accepted entrance exam such as JEE Main.Step 2:Then appear for the JEE Main exam.Step 3:Appear for the counselling round.Step 4:Pay the admission fee at the selected and the allotted college.

nirf.description:

One can observe that within the category of 'Engineering', the institute's ranking has steadiness when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, NIT Trichy's rank is #9, the same as last year's rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
The institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'Management' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, but a bad climate in the summer. There are exceptional peers.
reviews.review_text: The library facility, octagon, or if I say anything in the college, is just on a different level, except for hostels. Being a college affiliated with NIRF 9, we expect much better from their side in hostel management. There is no responsibility on their part if a theft happens. Actually, two laptops were stolen. The library must have a proper internet connection, which is bad. The hostel is improving right now with proper renovation after our complaints. It serves very good mess food. I'll say m...

reviews.review_heading: It has one of the best placement records. Classes are a bit hectic, but overall, it's good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and mess facilities are among the best across all NITs and IITs. We have high-speed Wi-Fi in each room. The mess food is great compared to other top colleges. There is a curfew for first-year boys. For girls, it is for all four years. We have an NIT Hospital for medical issues or emergencies. NIT Trichy has one of the top sports infrastructures.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college with decent facilities. But the climate is very hot and there is language barrier.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are not up to the mark. There are equipments in our lab, but very less in number, and that too sometimes does not work properly. We don't even have the basic facilities like water purifier, it's very hard for us to fill our water bottles from different hostels. We have good computer lab and library, but we don't have Wi-Fi in library. The quality is really nice, they provide amul butter, kellogg's corn flakes, fresh bread, and fruits (It varies from mess to mess, but overall quali...

reviews.review_heading: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.

reviews.review_heading: The institute offers strong academics and campus life, with scope for better industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides 24×7 high-speed Wi-Fi across academic blocks and hostels. Laboratories consist of computer labs with high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. They are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and audio systems.

reviews.review_heading: It is a fine college if you take higher branches like ECE, CS, EEE, mechanical, and chemical.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are above average. Wi-Fi is installed in every room, now no problem with Wi-Fi. Quality of the hostel is good. Mess food is also good. Here they emphasize sports and extracurricular activities also. They also organise events, guest lectures, and workshops.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life and experience in NIT Trichy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Classes for all department students occur in academic blocks like Orion and Logos, but we suffer in summer due to the high temperature of Trichy. The hostel facilities are also quite good. Every room has Wi-Fi. This year, they also introduced washing machines, which are on a pay-and-use system. I give 3/5 for the food because the taste does not seem good, and the varieties are also repeated. You can find many canteens, and you can also find Domino’s and CCD. The ...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure but disappointing in some aspects.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice. Hostels are not that much good as their NIRF is 9 but not too bad, it's okay to have such a hostel. College infrastructure is very nice. Library is also good. Food is not good in the first year but for North and South people they have different messes in college.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the course.
reviews.review_text: Almost everything is right in its place. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel rooms with routers in each room. Labs are there in every department, and classrooms will be happening in Orion. The library is present with well-structured and department-wise sections. Every day, the hostel is cleaned by workers and is maintained very hygienically. For food, we have Annapurna mess, Mega mess, and Sabari mess. The quality of food varies from mess to mess, and overall quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for this course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided in the room include a table, chair, almirah and a bed. The mess food is okay, not so good, but one will get used to it. If we talk about the books and journals available in the library, they are easily accessible to all the students and professors. The classrooms have high-quality projectors and speakers, and teachers use a microphone to deliver their lectures. There are a lot of sports available on campus, and everyone can play any sport they want to play.

reviews.review_heading: If you want, then you can join, but you have to score well on the GATE entrance.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are decent, I think. In the first year, there are 3 people in a single room, while the room can hold three people, the cupboards provided are for only two people. Wi-Fi all over the campus with cctv security. Labs are good. The library is good, it has all types of books. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are many grounds for different sports. There is also a swimming pool.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good location, good IIT.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good, like every other college. Cleanliness is a factor that the hostels possess. Sports and extracurricular activities are good in college. But unlike many IITs, they won't offer coaches to the respective college teams. There is Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and all types of books are available.

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.

reviews.review_heading: I like my institute so much for the best environment.
reviews.review_text: The buildings of my institute, that is NIT Trichy, are so good and well structured, and the most important thing is that the greenery here is so good. The hostel is well-furnished and also provides Wi-Fi facilities, and the mess food is not that bad to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Good environment and peaceful campus.
reviews.review_text:
It's a good environment to stay in, and it's full of facilities available. 
The library is filled with all types of journals, and e-books are also available in the library. 
Classrooms are neat, and good seating facilities are available on the campus. 
There are all types of sports and training available.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: First, clear the CAT, then think about this college.

content.Placements: Placements commence for us in the 3rd semester, and there is a 100% placement rate. Companies like Wells Fargo, McKinsey, Axtria, etc., visit and give about 50+ offers. The highest package is around 24 lac/annum, and the average is about 16 lac/annum. For internships, companies like ICICI Bank and Emphasis visit. The roles offered are diverse, from Data Analyst to Product Management, and the total stipend ranges from 1-200,000 for most internships. It gives the students very good industry exposure.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good. The hostel fee is about 10-15000 for a semester. The library offers a wide range of books from academic to non-academic. We can also make their virtual copy available via the library app and website. The classrooms have AC, a blackboard, & a projector. The IITK offers a wide range of sports, from football, cricket, skating, and boxing etc. Anyone who is interested in any of these activities can come and play.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Mathematics - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: IIT Kanpur College review.

content.Placements: Every single student who went for placement ended up getting a spot in coaching institutes like Physics Wallah and Prutor, with packages typically ranging from about 6 to 7 LPA. When it comes to math, it seems like a lot of folks are looking to pursue their Ph.D., whether in India or overseas, if we are talking placements, Statistics is actually doing better than Mathematics in our department.
content.Infrastructure: Talking about the colleges infrastructure, it includes all the basics, clean water supply, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports, there is also a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students can take advantage of transportation and on-campus housing if they do not have their own rides, the mess is kept clean, and while the food is pretty good, I think adding more choices that students like would be a bonus.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: IIT Kanpur College review.

faqs.question: Can we get direct admission in IIT Kanpur?
faqs.answer: IIT Kanpur only offers merit-based admission for all the courses. The institute accepts JEE Advanced scores for admission to BTech. Candidates need to pass JEE Main exam prior to appearing for JEE Advanced. Apart from its flagship programme, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT Kanpur) offers BSc, BS, MTech, MSc, MDes, MBA, along with a few Dual Degree programmes. Admission to all courses is based on scores obtained in the entrance examinations such as GATE, IIT JAM, CEED and CAT. Along with UG and PG courses, IIT Kanpur also offers PhD in various specialisations, admisison to which again is entrance-based.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in IIT Kanpur in BTech if my JEE Advanced rank is between 10000 and 15000?
faqs.answer: The cut off rank in Round 6 for B.Sc. in Chemistry is 11824 which is very close to this range. This was for general category under All India quota. Unless the candidate belongs to some other category or domicile, one can not afford to score less than this. With this rank, there is a probability of getting admission however since, the cut offs keep changing from round to round, better ranks definitely increases your chances of getting admission in IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology.

faqs.answer: IIT Kanpur MBA total tuition fee ranges between INR 2.8 Lacs and INR 13.1 Lacs as per an unofficial source. The fee is low (INR 800) for SC/ ST/ DAP candidates.

reviews.review_heading: First, clear the CAT, then think about this college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good. The hostel fee is about 10-15000 for a semester. The library offers a wide range of books from academic to non-academic. We can also make their virtual copy available via the library app and website. The classrooms have AC, a blackboard, & a projector. The IITK offers a wide range of sports, from football, cricket, skating, and boxing etc. Anyone who is interested in any of these activities can come and play.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Kanpur College review.
reviews.review_text: Talking about the colleges infrastructure, it includes all the basics, clean water supply, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports, there is also a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students can take advantage of transportation and on-campus housing if they do not have their own rides, the mess is kept clean, and while the food is pretty good, I think adding more choices that students like would be a bonus.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs are average and not cleaned on a daily basis. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is not acceptable. Wi-Fi facilities are only for faculty members. The hostel rooms are not so comfortable and very small. Sports and medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Kanpur College review.
reviews.review_text: The college has pretty solid infrastructure and decent amenities, You know, the on-campus housing is actually quite comfy and well-managed. A lot of students choose to live there. As for the food service, it’s okay, meets the basic standards, nothing fancy.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Kanpur College review.
reviews.review_text: The campus comprises all the required academic and research buildings, a central library, well-equipped labs, and classrooms that have Wi-Fi accessibility. In addition to this, students may use the residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation is generally considered satisfactory. The food in the mess is middling, and the health center is staffed with medical professionals who are there to help if someone falls sick.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library, and all things are present. The food is very good. Medical facilities are available. Sports and games are also present in the college.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Kanpur for Ph.D. CE and other stream course admission information.
reviews.review_text: In this college, infrastructure is also good because it is a top college for this course. In this college, facilities are provided like classrooms, labs, a hostel, a bathroom, a library, a canteen, an auditorium, a lift, CCTV, etc. Facilities are available. Sports and games facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Kanpur is about admission, campus, faculty, students, and exams.
reviews.review_text: This college provides good facilities such as fast Wi-Fi, Ethernet connections, labs, computers, CCTV, lifts, a campus canteen, and water purifier machines. Sports committees organize many sports and game tournaments, and gym facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: The best four years that I will spend.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is great, and labs are a bit hectic, but the infrastructure is top-class. The library has an occupancy of around 500 students and is a three-storey building. The infrastructure of hostels is quite old, so in the beginning, it might be difficult to live as there is no AC. The food quality in the mess is better than that of any other engineering college. The health centre at IIT Kanpur provides medicine and treatment completely free of cost. The campus provides facilities for all so...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vishnu Shiksha.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are very good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library ,all these things are available in my course. The quality and facilities present in my hostel, including food, are very good. Medical help is also present in this course. Sports and games are available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Shaswat's review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course were super. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and the library were all available. The quality of food in the college canteen was very good. Medical facilities were available. Sports and games were also provided for students at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college, good facilities, enjoyable fests, but hard academics.
reviews.review_text: The lecture halls are excellent, fully furnished, and equipped with AC. There are different labs for various purposes, equipped with computers for student use. A vast library is also available for the use of students and faculty, with a large number of books. The hostel has all the facilities for mess and sports. The quality of food being served in the mess is above average. Medical facilities are also provided on campus, with an ambulance available whenever needed

reviews.review_heading: The culture here is nice, but academics are a bit hectic.
reviews.review_text: We have high-speed Wi-Fi in our hostels, classrooms, and labs. The infrastructure for EE is a bit old, as it is one of the oldest branches, but it's fine. Labs are working well. The quality of food in hostels is fine. Sports here are top tier. Medical facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with services and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very clean and surrounded by plants and trees everywhere. Classrooms and labs are well-maintained and modified with all requirements. A well-stocked library is also available. Multiple sports and medical facilities, along with coaches, are present.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel, library, and classrooms, Wi-Fi is always available. They are very clean and hygienic. Even food tastes like home-made food. Sports and game facilities are available to interested students. We can also develop games by joining clubs which teach these things.

faqs.answer: A:    No, there is no provision of a student studying free at IIT Patna as per the official website. However, IIT Patna provides a range of Merit-Cum-Means scholarships to meritorious and needy students. Any UG (BTech) student or MSc student can receive these scholarships. The criteria to receive is that the annual income of a student's parents/ guardian/ family from all sources in the preceding financial year must not be more than INR 4.50 lakh. Category-wise eligibility criteria and the way in which the scholarship is offered is as follows:CategoryScholarship EligibilityScholarship ProvidedGen & OBC studentsFor new entrants: Their SPI will be the criteria for merit + Minimum SPI is 6.50 and no "F" grade in any of the courses in the first semester + Annual Family income must be less than INR 4.5 lakh For 2nd-year students (BTech/MSc): Minimum CPI is 6.50 and no "F" gradeINR 1,000 per month is provided for two semesters along with a full tuition fee waiverSC and ST studentsFor new entrants: Their SPI will be the criteria for merit + No "F" grade in any of the courses in the first semester + Annual Family income must be less than INR 4.5 lakh For 2nd-year students (BTech/MSc): No "F" grade in any of the coursesFree mess, exemption from hostel room rent and pocket allowance of INR 250 per monthA few more PG scholarships and UG scholarships offered by the PM are awarded to the students of IIT Patna.

They also need National/State Level Entrance (i.e., JEE (Advanced/Main), NEET, CUET, BITSAT, KVPY/NTSE/INSPIRE scholarship holders, State Entrance Examinations).
faqs.question: Does IIT Patna accept CUET score?

faqs.answer: A:    IIT Patna accepts multiple state/national entrance exams other than JEE advance for admission to BSc courses. NEET, CUET, BITSAT, etc.,  are other exams accepted by the institute. However, candidates must make sure to first qualify for the BSc eligibility criteria. Qualified candidates just need to apply via the official website of IIT Patna. BSc eligibility criteria: Class 12 in Science Stream with 60% aggregateTherefore, even if a student doesn't have a JEE Advanced score, they can always go for other entrance exam for admission. Howvever, candidates must make sure to qualify for any one of the entrance exam mentioned, in order to get admission to the BSc cousre at IIT Patna.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Material Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: IIT Patna college honest review.

content.Placements: The placement in our college was very good as it was one of the top engineering colleges of India. The placement percentage was around 80 percent. The highest package offered in our course was 24 LPA. Top recruiters in our course were Larsen and Turbo, Vedanta LTD, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure were top-notch for the Metallurgical and Materials Engineering branch. Wi-Fi facility, modern labs, and central library were present in the college campus. Hostel facility was also good. Washrooms were clean, fresh water was available, and a sports complex was present.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the college. IIT Patna is a rapidly growing 2nd generation IIT..

content.Placements: Placements are good and are still ongoing. The data for this year is not out yet, but it is said that in my course, 70% of students are placed. Many got internships in the 3rd year and PPOs from that. EEE has an average package of 17 LPA. Roles like SDE and Consultancy are offered, with placements rapidly improving year by year.
content.Infrastructure: All hostels have Wi-Fi installed. Three students share one room in the 1st year boys’ hostel. The newly built library is now open and centrally located. Labs and workshops are well-equipped with all necessary equipment. CLH is amazing with big classrooms. Each department has its own building where research and practical work take place.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: If you want to explore and have fun than its better to choose any old IITs.

content.Placements: Placement is pretty good almost all good companies come to college especially FAANG and over 90 percent got placed in CSE. The average package of my branch is about 24 LPA and last year, the highest package is about 80 LPA, while at the college, the highest package is about 1.3cr, which is given to a student of the AIDS branch.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are good but the instruments are old. Wi-Fi is available everywhere, including the hostel, academic building and lecture hall. The library is good and big but during exam time, it has a shortage of seats as all the students come and study overnight. There are not as many canteens and food stalls in comparison to old IITs that is a big problem and also Blinkit , Instamart, Zepto is not available only Jio smart is available but that not sufficient.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: IIT Patna M.Tech honest college review.

content.Placements: Placements at the institute are the perfect definition of it. Students generally become eligible for placement from the fourth semester. Around 300 recruiters participate, including top domestic as well as foreign companies. The average package for the M.Tech programme is 16 LPA, and the highest package offered is 1 CPA. The top recruiters in the drive include Microsoft, Oracle, Goldman Sachs, ICICI, Tata, and HCL. Almost 100 percent of students got placed. I plan to work after my graduation.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms are good in all aspects. 24 hour electricity is provided, and an emergency generator facility is available. The hostel is neat and clean. Sweepers come regularly to clean the dirty areas, and rooms are properly cleaned every weekend. The mess maintains good quality food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is a really good college with great campus life and good placements.

content.Placements: Around 80 percent of total registered students get placed in the Metallurgical and Materials Engineering branch. The highest package is 51 LPA, the average is around 15 LPA, and the lowest is 10 LPA. Top companies are Google, Microsoft, and Facebook. Around 60 percent of students get internships. The top roles are software engineer and consultant.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch for Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at IIT Patna. There are almost all labs for every subject. The infrastructure for lectures and tutorials are top-notch. Hostel infrastructure is very clean and top-notch, and the mess is also good.

faqs.question: What is the salary package offered during IIT Patna placements?
faqs.answer: The highest package offered during IIT Patna placements 2026 was INR 117 LPA. During the placement drive 2024, it was INR 144 LPA. BTech and MTech average package at the end of Phase 1 placement 2025-26 was INR 25.82 LPA and 16.2 LPA. Earlier, as per the placement brochure 2024-25, the average package offered during IIT Patna placements 2024 for BTech, M.Tech and MSc programs stood at around INR 17 LPA, INR 15 LPA and INR 7 LPA, respectively. The course-wise average package offered over the past three years during IIT Patna placements is presented below: Course Average Package (2021) Average Package (2022) Average Package (2023) BTech INR 17.13 LPA INR 28.86 LPA INR 24.56 LPA MTech INR 12.22 LPA INR 14.99 LPA INR 15.77 LPA MSc INR 6.97 LPA INR 6.86 LPA INR 9.22 LPA

faqs.question: How many companies visit the campus during IIT Patna placements?
faqs.answer: A total of 90 companies visited the campus and 319 offers were made at the end of IIT Patna Phase 1 placements 2025-26. Earlier, 225 companies visited and 582 offers were made during the placement drive 2024-25.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Patna college honest review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure were top-notch for the Metallurgical and Materials Engineering branch. Wi-Fi facility, modern labs, and central library were present in the college campus. Hostel facility was also good. Washrooms were clean, fresh water was available, and a sports complex was present.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college. IIT Patna is a rapidly growing 2nd generation IIT..
reviews.review_text: All hostels have Wi-Fi installed. Three students share one room in the 1st year boys’ hostel. The newly built library is now open and centrally located. Labs and workshops are well-equipped with all necessary equipment. CLH is amazing with big classrooms. Each department has its own building where research and practical work take place.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to explore and have fun than its better to choose any old IITs.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good but the instruments are old. Wi-Fi is available everywhere, including the hostel, academic building and lecture hall. The library is good and big but during exam time, it has a shortage of seats as all the students come and study overnight. There are not as many canteens and food stalls in comparison to old IITs that is a big problem and also Blinkit , Instamart, Zepto is not available only Jio smart is available but that not sufficient.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Patna M.Tech honest college review.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are good in all aspects. 24 hour electricity is provided, and an emergency generator facility is available. The hostel is neat and clean. Sweepers come regularly to clean the dirty areas, and rooms are properly cleaned every weekend. The mess maintains good quality food.

reviews.review_heading: It is a really good college with great campus life and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-notch for Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at IIT Patna. There are almost all labs for every subject. The infrastructure for lectures and tutorials are top-notch. Hostel infrastructure is very clean and top-notch, and the mess is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied (worth it).
reviews.review_text: There are separate buildings/floors for different departments, and they have Wi-Fi in all, afaik. Labs are well-equipped and maintained properly. IIT Patna has a central library, which is very beautiful and the heart of the campus; it is a round-shaped building with many floors and Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are well-furnished, and Wi-Fi is available. There are many hostels, but the hostel allotted to freshers is CV Raman. It is well-furnished, and Wi-Fi is available. Mess food is decent. There ...

reviews.review_heading: Strong academic program with knowledgeable faculty.
reviews.review_text: IIT Patna offers comprehensive facilities including modern academic blocks, extensive land with advanced equipment, a well -stocked digital /physical library, a dedicated hostel with Wi-Fi, a hospital/wellness centre, and robust sports amenities. Food safety involves mandatory hygiene rules, outsourced catering with quality check, menu adjustment feedback, and a Jain food option.

reviews.review_heading: Comparing IIT Patna with other IITs.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good if I compare it with other colleges, many IITs have average or just the worst hostel, but here the infrastructure is good, the buildings are new. Mess is also good, but not that good, you can't expect so much from them. Some lifts are not working all the time in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: A day as IIT Patna B.Sc. student.
reviews.review_text: As we have campus immersion every 6 months for 10-15 days, we have the best facilities, hostel, mess, complete access to library, classrooms, gymkhana, and everything. We have a daily workshop in our college in which a teacher comes to guide us for our future.

reviews.review_heading: My review of the IIT Patna.
reviews.review_text: In the friendships structure, it is good for other IITs. It has 516 students and a big campus, but BS students cannot get hostel facilities. If you want hostel facilities, you can contact the IIT administration, who can allot you a hostel with all facilities like a gym and a khana.

reviews.review_heading: My college looks like heaven.
reviews.review_text: IIT Patna College's infrastructure is amazing, it looks like heaven. They have a big library, a big auditorium, and a garden area of 250 acres. The college looks like an angel. I love it, I like it, everything is amazing. Hostel infrastructure is good, mind-blowing, they have girls' and boys' separate hostel rooms.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good with the IIT tag.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Hostels are also good and well-maintained. The mess food is above average and not so good. We would not feel bad on campus because there are so many sports to play, indoors or outdoors, and of course, I must say that it's not enough.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities available for our course are very good. The classrooms and labs are modified and well-maintained. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is average. The hostel rooms are comfortable and clean. Multiple sports and medical facilities are available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is clean and peaceful. Faculty members are helpful. Placement ratio is too good.
reviews.review_text: IIT Patna is located on its permanent campus in Bihta. It has a well-developed infrastructure for both academic pursuits and student residential life. The institute has a central lecture hall and a tutorial building. Each department has well-equipped and fully functioning research and teaching laboratories.

reviews.review_heading: I'm absolutely satisfied because of the faculty and good placements in 2024.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well-planned and developed. The whole campus is covered with Wi-Fi, and the classrooms have smart boards. The labs are updated with the latest technology, computers, and have an Apple lab. The food available in the mess and canteen is freshly prepared and delivered with proper packaging. The campus also has medical facilities and organizes an annual sports meet.

faqs.question: Can I get Thapar University without JEE?
faqs.answer: No, JEE Main is mandatory for BTech admission in Thapar University. The candidate should have a valid score in JEE Main and attend counseling to get a seat. But for other UG and PG courses such as MSc, MA, and MCA, admissions are made on a merit basis, i.e., JEE is not mandatory.

faqs.question: Are admissions at Thapar University merit or entrance based?
faqs.answer: Admissions at Thapar University are both merit and entrance based. The selection criteria varies depending on the programme chosen. Certain courses like BTech are entrance based with the university accepting JEE MAIN scores for the same while certain courses like MSc, MCA etc. are merit based. The university accepts Class 12 scores for merit based admissions. Ensure that the minimum eligibility requirement is met and check the selection criteria very carefully before applying for admission to the preferred programme.

faqs.question: Can I take admission in MCA at Thapar University without CUET PG?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates can take admissions to the MCA course at Thapar University without CUET PG scores. Because the eligibility to get admissions to MCA is that candidates must complete their graduation from any stream with an aggregate of 60% (55% for reserved category). Moreover, the selection process is based on merit, which is evaluated on the basis of candidates' scores in their Class 10,  12, and graduation. Important thing to note is candidates are required to study Mathematics as one of the subjects in their Class 12 and graduation. Therefore, to get enrolled in MCA at Thapar University, CUET PG is not compulsory.

faqs.question: What are the job opportunities available after completing MCA course from Thapar University?
faqs.answer: Completion of the MCA (Master of Computer Applications) course from Thapar University can provide students with numerous job opportunities in the IT and technology sector. Some of the major career options candidates can pursue are as follows: Software Developer: Create, develop, and manage software programmes. This job usually demands expertise in programming languages such as Java, C+, Python, etc. Data Scientist: Examine and interpret complicated data in order to assist organisations in making well-informed decisions. Expertise in statistics, machine learning, and data visualization is essential. Database Administrator: Manage and upkeep databases, maintaining their performance, security, and availability. Cloud Architect: Design and develop cloud computing plans and infrastructure. Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud should be known.

reviews.review_text: Its a private college, infrastructure is absolutely top notch. Hostels are air conditioned and your classes are air conditioned. Right now my college is undergoing an overhaul. New infrastructure is being built so in the next 1 year this college will look nothing less than a 5 star property. The library is Indias the biggest and Asias 7th biggest so yeah. Hostels are top notch quality of food which is also decent unlike government hostels. All types of sports facilities are available on the camp...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty and decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities on campus are decent and sufficient for a student. The campus has Wi-Fi, well maintained computer labs, smart classrooms and a good well maintained library. Hostel facilities are average with basic amenities and cleanliness is maintained. The mess food is average and repetitive but the canteens provide additional options. Basic medical facilities for both indoor and outdoor activities.

reviews.review_heading: It is the drastic mistake of my life.
reviews.review_text: The college is excellent in terms of hostels and classrooms. But average in terms of labs. As many core experiments are done in groups of 10 people, giving little hands-on experience. Hostel facilities are high class with good food. Classrooms are also good and air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Extremely good infrastructure, nice faculty, but the fees are a bit high.
reviews.review_text: Superb hostels, nice bathrooms, Wi-Fi speed is mid but manageable. Labs have top-quality, up-to-date machines and instruments. Lecture halls are very good and in nice condition. Roads and stadiums are very good. Overall, nice infrastructure as well as 24th NIRF rank.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with AC campus but the mess food is average.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classroom are good. The library has a vast collection of books and reference material with large sitting areas. But the baggage area outside is quite small in comparison. The sports centre is great, and has good quality equipment. The food in hostels is not that great though.

reviews.review_heading: This college is something great that everyone should experience. The infrastructure is top-notch.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi in the whole building. Library is great, very beautifully made, and the labs are well maintained with all equipments. We have all medical facilities, and mess food is all delicious with hygiene maintained. We have all the games from table tennis to swimming. Infrastructure is good, very clean and maintained,

reviews.review_heading: Decent faculty, placements, great infrastructure, and enjoyable campus life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are great here, in fact, one of the best compared to other colleges. Fully air conditioned classrooms, the biggest library in India, and Wi-Fi connectivity are available in every block. Hostels are no less, they provide the best facilities here. The mess food is reasonable, medical is a call away, you can use the gym, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great. The library is very beautiful and big. Wi-Fi is great. It's available everywhere. Labs have very good infrastructure. Hostels are also great. But the food in the mess is not that great. Medical facilities are also great. You can get an emergency ambulance whenever needed.

reviews.review_heading: It is great, but not good value for money.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure here. Wi-Fi, very cool buildings. Classrooms are almost the latest, and now the remaining blocks are also getting renovated. It would be a great course to join, a great college, and teachers. I haven't been to a hostel, but they are dope.

reviews.review_heading: High fees but nice faculty, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities, and scholarships.
reviews.review_text: World-class research facilities, antenna research lab, done and intelligent sensors lab, MEMS research lab, optical fibre communication research lab, smart autonomous electric vehicle lab, Thapsat research lab, wireless communication lab. Good classrooms with mostly air-conditioned, free wi-fi around the academic area and in hostels. Very big and spacious five-storied air-conditioned Nalanda Central Library with modern technology. There are 16 hostels, most of which are conditioned. Mess, laundr...

reviews.review_heading: Thapar provides many opportunities, a great infrastructure, and good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Thapar has very good Wi-Fi connectivity throughout the campus, even within hostels. Labs are great with modern infrastructure. Hostels are nice with AC, joint washrooms, and great mess food. Thapar has the most beautiful and large library with all types of books for any field (B.Tech, law, civil services, etc. Thapar has a free health care centre with good doctors for any issue. Ambulance services are also available 24x7. It has a very nice sports culture with many sports and coaches for every s...

reviews.review_heading: One of the better choices around 90-96%.
reviews.review_text: Apart from small, a few ifs and but's here and there, the facilities on campus are nice. There are many places to hangout, and AC is installed in 90% of the classes and hostels to assist in scorching heat of Patiala. The library being the main attraction, provides more than enough books for every category.

reviews.review_heading: Expensive but provides facilities for it. Amazing infrastructure, average placements and teachers.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are top notch, massive sitting space, well air conditioned, working Wi-Fi throughout campus, and well-maintained massive library with all types of books with discussion areas. Strict rules for the library not allowing eating stuff with a library card for entry. Infrastructure of library is fabulous allowing a very calm and peaceful space for working. Hostel facilities depend on hostel with mess for each hostel providing quality food. Rooms with and without non-AC. A canteen for evenin...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure like foreign universities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely attractive to us. Sports facilities were also available. Medical facility was present.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure with a guaranteed fun college life.
reviews.review_text: Mess services are great as they are catered by Sodexo, and hostels are fairly maintained. The rooms are neither too tight nor too big but the right size. They are cleaned regularly by the staff, and the food in the mess is hygienic with no compromises in taste.

reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the overall experience, good environment, and decent infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: College provides no placement opportunities as such, but it organises several exhibitions and fests to give the students enough exposure to get placed. The package can start from Rs 20,000 per month and go upto Rs 80,000 for freshers. It depends entirely on the skill set of the students. Students can work as graphic designer, UI UX designer, illustration artist, or animator.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostels are well maintained and have all the basic necessities like Wi-Fi and air-conditioned libraries. The campus has decent infrastructure. The washrooms are not that great and need regular cleaning. Classrooms are well-ventilated. The food quality in the mess and the canteen is average but eatable. Medical facilities are barely provided. There is a huge sports complex at gate number 3.

reviews_list.review_title: Jamia Millia Islamia review

review_content.Placements: The placement in our course was not good in any college because it is an academic course, not a vocational course. Students also got internships in various institutes.
