individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is very good and the faculty is very helpful in every advice or term.

content.Placements: The placement records are on the notice board. About 80 percent of students get internships. The highest is 12 LPA, and the lowest is 7 LPA. I don’t know the top roles, but they are majorly corporate and some are semi-government. Overall, students are very happy with it.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty good. The Wi-Fi and the canteen food are also decent. Sports happen every month, and a lot of students participate in them. Prizes are also decent, like vouchers and electronic gadgets, which are very helpful for students and increase their productivity.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Affordable and superb infrastructure college.

content.Placements: A total of 48 students got placed in 2025, and the highest is about 18.56 LPA in Optum, and the lowest is in TCS Ninja with 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Optum, HCL, Accenture, Visa, IDFC, HSBC, etc. Around 40 percent of students got their internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top-class. Although the area is not that big because of the Delhi location, the overall infrastructure is the best. Jamia has its sports complex where Ranji matches are also held, and all facilities are available. Hostel charges are about Rs. 40,000 per year, including mess and accommodation.

individual_reviews.course: BFA in Applied Art - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the overall experience, good environment, and decent infrastructure.

content.Placements: College provides no placement opportunities as such, but it organises several exhibitions and fests to give the students enough exposure to get placed. The package can start from Rs 20,000 per month and go upto Rs 80,000 for freshers. It depends entirely on the skill set of the students. Students can work as graphic designer, UI UX designer, illustration artist, or animator.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are well maintained and have all the basic necessities like Wi-Fi and air-conditioned libraries. The campus has decent infrastructure. The washrooms are not that great and need regular cleaning. Classrooms are well-ventilated. The food quality in the mess and the canteen is average but eatable. Medical facilities are barely provided. There is a huge sports complex at gate number 3.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Sanskrit - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Jamia Millia Islamia review

content.Placements: The placement in our course was not good in any college because it is an academic course, not a vocational course. The career options after this are assistant professor, teacher, or translator. Some companies like BPO/Customer Care recruit us with a salary of 3–4 LPA. Students also got internships in various institutes.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central library was present. Classrooms were integrated with digital TV. The quality of the hostel was extremely good, but the hostel capacity was very less, so most students could not get hostel accommodation.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. Hons. in French and Francophone Studies - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of Jamia Millia Islamia.

content.Placements: The placement in our course is not quite good, but it has a good curriculum and alumni network as compared to other colleges. The package offered in our course is around 4-5 LPA. Some translating firms hire us. Around 70 percent of students get internship offers.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are good. A central library is present. The hostel quality and our faculty members are good. All essential facilities are available. Food and canteen food are good.

Counseling: Selected candidates are called for counseling or interview rounds to further evaluate their eligibility for admission. Admission: The candidate must pay the admission fee and complete the admission process, which may include document verification, seat confirmation, and submission of required documents. As for the admission form, you can obtain it from the respective college or university's official website or admission office. You can fill the form online or download it and submit it offline. faqs.question: Does Jamia Millia Islamia accept CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jamia Millia Islamia accepts CUET scores for UG courses such as BA, BSc and BVoc. Jamia Millia Islamia admission is based on entrance exam score. The university released its prospectus for admissions in March with the schedule for admission to courses accepting national-level and university-level entrance exams. JMI, New Delhi offers over 220 courses in both regular and self-financed modes. The university also provides distance learning courses at undergraduate (UG), postgraduate (PG), and Diploma levels.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia admission to UG and PG courses is entrance exams based. The university accepts JMI entrance exam, CUET and JEE Main for admission. Further, to be eligible for admission, students also need to pass Class 12 with 50% for admission to UG courses and a graduation degree with 50-55% aggregate for admission to PG courses.

faqs.question: What is the reservation percentage for Muslim candidates at JMI?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia offers seat reservations in almost all the courses based on the category of the students. Candidates seekingJMI admissionunder the reserved category can apply for reservation under one category only and are required to fulfil the prescribed eligibility conditions of the course. reviews.review_heading: College is very good and the faculty is very helpful in every advice or term.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good. The Wi-Fi and the canteen food are also decent. Sports happen every month, and a lot of students participate in them. Prizes are also decent, like vouchers and electronic gadgets, which are very helpful for students and increase their productivity.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable and superb infrastructure college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-class. Although the area is not that big because of the Delhi location, the overall infrastructure is the best. Jamia has its sports complex where Ranji matches are also held, and all facilities are available. Hostel charges are about Rs. 40,000 per year, including mess and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the overall experience, good environment, and decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are well maintained and have all the basic necessities like Wi-Fi and air-conditioned libraries. The campus has decent infrastructure. The washrooms are not that great and need regular cleaning. Classrooms are well-ventilated. The food quality in the mess and the canteen is average but eatable. Medical facilities are barely provided. There is a huge sports complex at gate number 3.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Millia Islamia review
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central library was present. Classrooms were integrated with digital TV. The quality of the hostel was extremely good, but the hostel capacity was very less, so most students could not get hostel accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jamia Millia Islamia.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are good. A central library is present. The hostel quality and our faculty members are good. All essential facilities are available. Food and canteen food are good.

reviews.review_heading: Development extension - Professional course.
reviews.review_text: All the students had access to Wi-Fi and library. Library at Jamia was very good, and the classrooms of the department were average. The hostel was very good. The quality of food was also good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by A.J.K. Mass Communication Research CentreReviewed on 24 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best college for mass communication.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central Library was present. The quality of the hostel was awesome, but it's rare to get a hostel. A medical facility was available in the college. A sports and games complex was available.

reviews.review_heading: It's a beautiful campus and a well-reputed university, and the teaching staff is great.
reviews.review_text: The hostel accommodation began by December, while I secured a seat in August itself. So it got a little difficult for me. The room is nice, spacious with a 3 seater, food was okay, we used to get veg and non-veg both. The quality was not great but decent. Seats are very much limited, this is one issue. The hostel is 1.5 km away from the college. Hostel fee is INR 48,000 per year. They need improvement in terms of class infrastructure, smart boards and projects are needed.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the quality of the course.
reviews.review_text: Our department is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, AC, a water purifier, and a projector. To conduct experiments, all necessary facilities are available in our lab, including RT-PCR, qPCR, BSL-2, a cell culture room, and a Virus culture lab. Our university has a central library near my department, where you can issue any two books for 14 days. The central canteen has good quality food at a cheap rate, and many other shops are also there. Cricket ground and other sports grounds are working, you ca...

reviews.review_heading: JMI: A central university in New Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms have AC for 2nd year students onwards, and the seats are good. Sometimes issues are faced that are resolved within a few days. Wi-Fi is available. FET library is working from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays. The central library in a block remains open from 9:00 AM-2:AM, except national holidays.

reviews.review_heading: Very good faculty and very nice experience.
reviews.review_text: There are six boys' hostels named F.R.K, A.P.J, B.R.A, A.M.K, Kelat, and S.R.K (Alma Iqbal is not available right now). The hostels and mess are very affordable, with hygienic and nutritious food. The engineering department has one big building with different sections for different departments. The library has AC and Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, but 2024 was not a good year for engineering.
reviews.review_text: All five departments, Computer, Electronic, Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil, have a common building. There is one separate building for the library and reading room, fully air-conditioned with centralized Wi-Fi. Electrical Engineering classes have no AC. In Jamia, there are 7 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic and very affordable. Hostel costs around Rs. 40,000 per year for mess and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, everything is okay.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Department is also good. Wi-Fi is good. Classrooms are not too much good. Library is excellent. The food quality is not too much good in mess. Canteen food is good. Medical facilities are free which is good. Sports and games are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with placement but very good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The quality of mess food is good, especially in A.P.J. hostel and F.R.K. hostel. There are 3 girls' hostels and 6 or 7 boys' hostels, and there are many canteens in Jamia with affordable prices. Sports facilities are available, as well as a clinic. The engineering department has one building, and there is another building for the reading room and library.

reviews.review_heading: 2022 is the best year for electrical engineering.
reviews.review_text: The overall campus is good. The buildings are good, and the dentistry building is very nice, well-maintained, and well-designed. The engineering department has a personal library and reading room, and all 5 departments of engineering have a common building. There are a total of 6 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic, and the food is decent at a reasonable price. Jamia has a sports complex and a free clinic for students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: An absolutely amazing college, and better than taking a drop.

review_content.Placements: In Mechanical engineering, 120 out of 200 students got placed. Top recruiting companies are Bajaj, Ford, L&T, Tata Motors, and Goldman Sachs. Top roles are software engineer, data analyst, finance, and general manager. The highest package is 34 LPA, the average is 9.2 LPA, and the lowest is 5 LPA. Internship rate is 20 percent.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi in all hostels, labs, classrooms, etc. More than sufficient non-veg food is available, but veg food quality is debatable. Top medical facilities are available. Multiple ambulances are present 24/7. The college provides free bus transport across campus. All sports are played here, mainly football, basketball, badminton, and handball. Two large plain sandy grounds pending infrastructure, an upcoming indoor sports complex, obviously all these things will also be available after we leave this college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Strong curriculum and a good culture of extra activities.

review_content.Placements: About 85% of students who participated in the placement drive were placed in the 2024-25 placement, with the lowest package of 5 LPA and the highest of 43 LPA, with an average of 13.8 LPA. Core placement was less for B.Tech ECE students, and most of it was for software companies. For internships, 22.7% of students who registered secured one for the year 2025.
review_content.Infrastructure: NIT Calicut has one of the greatest infrastructures compared to many other colleges. Every classroom has Wi-Fi, projectors, etc. The technical team is quickly available whenever there are any issues regarding these while taking classes. Food is also of good quality, maintaining diversity by providing foods from different parts of India. Sports teams and cultural clubs are also very active in NIT Calicut. I think NIT Calicut is the NIT with the most number of clubs, which include both technical and cultural.

overview_faqs.question: Is NIT Calicut worth all the hype?
overview_faqs.answer: National Institute of Technology, Calicut, also known as NIT Calicut, is one of the oldest NITs in India and has been ranked 2 under the 'Architecture and Planning' category and 21 under the 'Engineering' category by NIRF 2025. The college offers a wide range of programmes to students, mainly in the Engineering and Technology fields. Further, the college has a decent connection with top-notch companies such as Accenture, ADP, Amazon, Amdocs, Baja Auto, American Express, etc.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Calicut Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The highest package last year was 50.64 LPA.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed in our college is 80 percent. The highest package in our college is 50.64 LPA, and the average package in our college is 18.75 LPA. Many MNCs are coming to our college to hire students. The top role offered in our branch is a VLSI design engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Many facilities are also provided in our college, like a cricket ground, a football ground, and many others. Wi-Fi facility is also provided in our college. The mess food is also acceptable, and a health center is also available in our college, and many sports are also available in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The highest package in our college was 50.64 LPA in 2025.

content.Placements: Last year, our campus placement was 90 percent. The highest package was 50.64 LPA, and the average package was 12.17. Top roles offered in our branch were VLSI design engineer, and the internship percentage was 24.4 percent of students were interns, and PG students were 18.62 percent.
content.Infrastructure: We have separate buildings for class and labs. We also have a huge library where we can read many books, and a Wi-Fi facility is available in our hostels. Mess food is acceptable, a health center is also available in our college, and there are three canteens in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: An absolutely amazing college, and better than taking a drop.

content.Placements: In Mechanical engineering, 120 out of 200 students got placed. Top recruiting companies are Bajaj, Ford, L&T, Tata Motors, and Goldman Sachs. Top roles are software engineer, data analyst, finance, and general manager. The highest package is 34 LPA, the average is 9.2 LPA, and the lowest is 5 LPA. Internship rate is 20 percent.
content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi in all hostels, labs, classrooms, etc. More than sufficient non-veg food is available, but veg food quality is debatable. Top medical facilities are available. Multiple ambulances are present 24/7. The college provides free bus transport across campus. All sports are played here, mainly football, basketball, badminton, and handball. Two large plain sandy grounds pending infrastructure, an upcoming indoor sports complex, obviously all these things will also be available after we leave this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Strong curriculum and a good culture of extra activities.

content.Placements: About 85% of students who participated in the placement drive were placed in the 2024-25 placement, with the lowest package of 5 LPA and the highest of 43 LPA, with an average of 13.8 LPA. Core placement was less for B.Tech ECE students, and most of it was for software companies. For internships, 22.7% of students who registered secured one for the year 2025.
content.Infrastructure: NIT Calicut has one of the greatest infrastructures compared to many other colleges. Every classroom has Wi-Fi, projectors, etc. The technical team is quickly available whenever there are any issues regarding these while taking classes. Food is also of good quality, maintaining diversity by providing foods from different parts of India. Sports teams and cultural clubs are also very active in NIT Calicut. I think NIT Calicut is the NIT with the most number of clubs, which include both technical and cultural.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Last year many students got placed in our college.

content.Placements: 84.67 percent of our college students were placed last year. The highest package of our college is 50.64 LPA, and the average package is 13.28 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Samsung, Microsoft, and many more. 22 percent of students got internships in the summer, and the top role is a VLSI designer.
content.Infrastructure: Many facilities are available in our college for the ECE department. We have a library with many resources in it, and there is also a separate lab for the ECE department. The classrooms are also huge. There are Wi-Fi facilities in our hostels and a health center.

Admission to the National Institute of Technology, Calicut courses is done on an entrance basis. The admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. For admission to thefour-year Integrated Teacher Education (ITEP) programme, candidates can reach out to the admission office contact number. TheJEE Advanced 2025official website has launched with the new eligibility criteria. As per the official website, candidates can now attempt theJEE Advanced 2025 exama maximum of three times in three consecutive years.Below is the complete process forNIT Calicut admission:
NIT Calicut Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at NIT Calicut are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. For admission to MBA, MA and PhD courses apply through NIT Clicut website.
Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Calicut admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats throughJoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Calicut MBA admissions are done through the CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Calicut cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

reviews.review_text: Many facilities are also provided in our college, like a cricket ground, a football ground, and many others. Wi-Fi facility is also provided in our college. The mess food is also acceptable, and a health center is also available in our college, and many sports are also available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: The highest package in our college was 50.64 LPA in 2025.
reviews.review_text: We have separate buildings for class and labs. We also have a huge library where we can read many books, and a Wi-Fi facility is available in our hostels. Mess food is acceptable, a health center is also available in our college, and there are three canteens in our college.

reviews.review_heading: An absolutely amazing college, and better than taking a drop.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi in all hostels, labs, classrooms, etc. More than sufficient non-veg food is available, but veg food quality is debatable. Top medical facilities are available. Multiple ambulances are present 24/7. The college provides free bus transport across campus. All sports are played here, mainly football, basketball, badminton, and handball. Two large plain sandy grounds pending infrastructure, an upcoming indoor sports complex, obviously all these things will also be available after we lea...

reviews.review_heading: Strong curriculum and a good culture of extra activities.
reviews.review_text: NIT Calicut has one of the greatest infrastructures compared to many other colleges. Every classroom has Wi-Fi, projectors, etc. The technical team is quickly available whenever there are any issues regarding these while taking classes. Food is also of good quality, maintaining diversity by providing foods from different parts of India. Sports teams and cultural clubs are also very active in NIT Calicut. I think NIT Calicut is the NIT with the most number of clubs, which include both technical a...

reviews.review_heading: Last year many students got placed in our college.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are available in our college for the ECE department. We have a library with many resources in it, and there is also a separate lab for the ECE department. The classrooms are also huge. There are Wi-Fi facilities in our hostels and a health center.

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology, Calicut.
reviews.review_text: There are so many canteens and hostel blocks. We have so many good facilities like canteens, playgrounds, a park, and a medical clinic. We have so many classrooms and labs with well-equipped requirements. In every corner, there are CCTV cameras in case of any further issues. We have a big library, and the hostel's food quality is so good.

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology Calicut.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very super. I enjoyed myself a lot in this hostel with my friends. We have so many good facilities here, like canteens, barber shops, groceries, etc. So many shops are available on the campus only. We have so many blocks for hostelers and classrooms. There are big library blocks 24/7 available. We have so many labs available for practical experiments to do with students. The hostel food quality is so good. We have a hospital here, and every day, any time we can play games, if we wa...

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Calicut - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Individual hostel facilities were available for first, second, third, and fourth-year students. Hostel security was very strict. Food prepared for the hostellers was always in limited proportion, and the food was not very tasty. Free Wi-Fi connectivity, 24-hour water facilities, and electricity were available in the hostel at all times.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and environment are really good.
reviews.review_text: NITC is a fully residential institution. The hostels are generally well-maintained, with good food and Wi-Fi connectivity. The campus is vast (around 300 acres), lush green, and offers a beautiful, eco-friendly environment. The food is great here. We have our own medical center here in NITC.

reviews.review_heading: College not only forces students to focus on marks also encourage in participation extracurricular.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are decent in our college. Wi-Fi is also provided for first years and a laundry facility too. The food is acceptable to eat not that good and not that bad. The security in the hostels is not that violent they will be polite with us.

reviews.review_heading: Really, it has good infrastructure and facilities available for the students.
reviews.review_text: They provide good Wi-Fi facilities for the students. In the academics, they also give the most good health Wi-Fi in college, and they provide nutritional food in your hostels and mess.

reviews.review_heading: This college has a good academic and non-academic staff.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are decent, and the night curfew time too, and the food is not that good. The hostel Wi-Fi is provided in the first-year hostel too, and laundry facility too. We have separate labs for electronics and programming, and the college also has a health centre where we get free doctor checkup and medicine.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Calicut is a heavenly college in god's own country.
reviews.review_text: The buildings and infrastructure are well maintained. It has regular maintenance and construction throughout the campus, making living here convenient and worth the money spent. Although the campus is very big. You might need a cycle for comfort.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Calicut College.
reviews.review_text:
When we talk about the college's infrastructure, it covers all the basics clean water supply, spacious science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports. There was a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students could also benefit from transportation and on-campus housing if they did not have their own rides. The mess was kept 
clean, and while the food was decent, I think adding a few more choices that students like would be a real bonus.

reviews.review_heading: About good campus life and hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good with changing room allotments by year. In the first year, rooms are shared by 3 students (earlier 4). Second and third years stay in the Mega hostel with 2 students per room. In the final year, students can choose the campus hostels or the Mega hostel, with a single room provided. Wi-Fi or LAN is provided to all the hostels. Mess food is better than that in many colleges, with multiple mess options available. There is a health center outside the main campus.

Currently, at NIT Calicut, there are 312 faculty members, spread over the cadres of Professor (HAG), Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor. The faculty members are highly qualified and are very helpful to students, be it academic or any other.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, okay placement.
reviews.review_text: In our institute, we have smart classrooms with a good internet connection. Our labs and library are very good, and the classrooms are well air-conditioned. Our hostel food is very nice, and we have good sanitation in our hostel. Wi-Fi is available but not too fast.

reviews.review_heading: Good, but if you do not take the risk of money, then come to study here. Otherwise, very good.
reviews.review_text: In the case of the hostel, the fees are 1,10,000 for 1 year, and according to it, the food is good in quality and quantity. The hostel infrastructure is also good and study-friendly. The faculty are good. For machine learning, high-quality labs are provided. In the library, the behavior of teachers is good and very friendly. Free medicine and minor treatment are provided by SUM IMS, SOA. No functions are organized by the college except for the annual function, but many smaller events are organiz...

reviews.review_heading: I chose the best inter for real.
reviews.review_text: The environment is so friendly. There are clean and neat classrooms. There is AC in every single class. The professors are friendly and understanding. The hostel is good, but the mess food is not that great. If you get into the habit, you will learn to adjust. The environment is so friendly.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best things about the university is that ragging is strictly prohibited on campus.
reviews.review_text: The biggest relief here is that almost all our classrooms are air-conditioned. For CSE, the labs are pretty solid, and we have dedicated labs. Most PCs have decent i5/i7 processors and run the necessary software without lagging. You get plenty of lab time, but strict attendance is maintained. There are multiple hostels for boys and girls. They are separate. You can choose between AC and Non AC rooms. The rooms are generally clean and tidy. Bathrooms are cleaned daily.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of job opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great, but the non-AC hostels are not that good. If you want to stay in good condition, I recommend staying out of the college in a flat or PG. PGs are great there and very cheap. You can find lots of them. The library, Wi-Fi, and canteens are great, and there is no problem there.

reviews.review_heading: Definitely a good university in Odisha.
reviews.review_text: You will definitely like the infrastructure, and the food is 8.5/10, depending on your personal Taste. You should definitely try the Biriyani, which you will definitely like. Mostly, you will get a variety of food, and most of the time, the food is edible and properly cooked.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Institute of Technical Education and Research.
reviews.review_text: There are very bad facilities, as they do not have any proper behavior. The food here is like they would give you food prepared under less hygienic conditions and leftover vegetables. The timing of the hostel is the worst. They treat our hostel like a ladies' hostel because our return timing is 7:00 PM.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is well organized. Professors are well qualified, and placement in the college is solid.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well organized. The labs are in perfect condition all the time, whether the Physics lab or the CSE labs. All have centralized AC and are perfect. The drainage system is fine inside the campus. The hostels are perfect as well (from a male perspective). The food is good. If you don't like the food, you can complain about it. At the end of the day, you will like the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: SOA is a mix of pros and cons.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure and good technical labs. Wi-Fi facility is available 24x7. All classrooms are smart. It also has a good central library where students can study. The hostel is not upto mark. Mess food is average. The hostel culture is also not that good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SOA University - Siksha 'O' Anusandhan.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good for safety issues. There is a good environment, but we have to face internet issues. Otherwise, everything is good, like cleaning. The food is average. Hostels are best for study and security. There is no ragging. It is under CCTV surveillance and always under monitoring conditions.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. They should conduct more events.
reviews.review_text: In our college, all the facilities are okay. The Wi-Fi speed is very slow and laggy. Classrooms and library are top notch not IIT level. Facilities quality is good. The quality of food is sometimes good sometimes not. Sports are also good over here and chances are given.

reviews.review_heading: Inter and Teach sounds weird.
reviews.review_text: I mean the Wi-Fi all over college, food , even the cafeteria and all are not pocket friendly. The medical facilities are nice and fine. Inter is well known for sports. Out of all 5 campuses, it has been maintaining the streak of being the SOA cup winners. We had a sports fest from Dec 4 - Jan 7th 2026. Even you have Inter College leagues, etc.

reviews.review_heading: An absolutely mediocre college with basic facilities but decent food and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel premises, but not in the library, which is disappointing. Labs and classrooms are decent. The library can be upgraded, but its alright. The quality of food is decent, better than what many other colleges offer. The hostel provides basic facilities. The campus does have a sports culture, but the area designed for sports related activities is quite small. Medical facilities are available. The college also hosts sports tournaments. I wi...

reviews.review_heading: Review of what a good experience was in my college life.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there were so many different types of courses available. Different courses had different blocks. Fully Wi-Fi available inside the college campus. Classrooms were smart rooms, and a big central library was also available on campus. In the hostel, they provided Wi-Fi, a gym, four times a day food, power backup, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my college opinion and my experience.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is so big and has full Wi-Fi. Classrooms are fully AC with smart rooms. One central library is also inside the campus. Inside the hostel, full Wi-Fi is available. Both indoor and outdoor sports facilities are available on the campus.

paragraphs: NIT Warangal admission 2025is entrance-based. National Institute of Technology (NIT) Warangal offers a list of courses at the UG, PG and PG Diploma levels. BTech is the flagship programme of the institute. Admission to undergraduate engineering, i.e., BTech atNIT Warangalis depnds on JEE Main. Applicable students can apply by going to the verified website of the National Testing Agency (NTA). Different national-level examinations allowed by the institute areCAT, MAT, GATE, IIT JAM, and NIMCET.

Prior to applying forNIT Warangal course admissions, it is suggested that the students should check the eligibility criteria specified particular to the course. However, for the MBA course, group discussions and personal interviews are conducted.
NITWarangal Admission 2025: Eligibility & Selection

TheNIT Warangal admission processfor most of the courses is entrance-based. Hence, applicants must have a valid score on the respective accepted entrance exam. NIT Warangal accepts the GATE score for MTech admission. Admission to the flagship course of NIT Warangal i.e. BTech is offered based on JEE Main score of the aspirants. students seekingadmission at NIT Warangalare required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, students have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, students seeking admission to PhD courses are through the official website (https://nitw.ac.in/).
2: Selection Rounds

The institute admits students with a valid JEE Main score for BTech courses. students are further allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However,NIT Warangal MBA admissionsare done through the CAT/ MAT scores. Aspirants further need to come for the personal interview round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Warangal cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted students need to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

placement_data.title: NIT Warangal Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: According to the placement report 2025 released by the Institute, NIT Warangal recorded placement rate of 79.3% in 2025 . The highest package offered during NIT Warangal placements 2025 was I NR 64.3 LPA . The average and median package received by students in 2025 was INR 14.35 LPA and INR 12 LPA , respectively. Further, 290 companies visited the campus ad 1225 offers were made as well.

Earlier, NIT Warangal highest package offered in 2024 stood at INR 88 LPA . The average package received by students during NIT Warangal placements 2024 was INR 15.6 LPA . The overall placement rate was 76%. More than 305 companies visited and 1,128 offers were made in 2024. A total of 1120 students were placed as well. NITK witnessed the return of the majority of past recruiters during placement drive 2023-24. There was also an increase in the number of new recruiters during this placement drive. IT sector emerged as the top recruiting sector that made 54% of the total full-time offers during the placement drive 2023-24. Top profiles in the areas such as Data Analysis, Software Engineering, Product Analysis , Consultancy , Management and Data Science were offered to students.

NIT Warangal has a dedicated Centre for Career Planning and Development (CCPD) that looks after all placement-related activities. Meanwhile, NIT Warangal placement process includes 6 steps. In the first step, invitations are sent to companies . In step 2 and 3, SPOCs are assigned to companies and placement drives are scheduled , respectively. The fourth and fifth steps includes Pre-Placement talks followed by tests and interviews . In the final step, shortlisted candidates get the offer letter from the respective companies.

reviews.review_heading: According to education it is good, but poor infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi good, labs okay, classrooms need improvement, and library excellent. Hostel contains better facilities, especially about food. NIT Warangal serves very quality and hygiene food, and also good in taste. Wi-Fi also gets everywhere in the campus and also good hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms in our branch department are very good and spacious. Wi-Fi is available in each classroom. Labs are well-maintained. The college library consists of more than 10 lakh books, which are open to everyone, and more than 10,000 e-books are also available. The hostels are good. The mess food is satisfactory. There is a food street as a canteen where we can get a variety of foods.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placement.
reviews.review_text: The NIT Warangal infrastructure is excellent, clean, and neat. The facilities are available 24/7 with a high-speed network. Classrooms are clean and neat, with one lab for each subject. The quality of food is good and hygienic, and they keep a variety of food daily. Sports and games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: Some hostels are good, but we are not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room, not even the iron. The weather is too hot, and we are not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. The library is good with all types of books. Technology-based books are also available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Warangal is a good college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not that good as washrooms are not cleaned every day, which makes it difficult, and the mess is average, though the food kept on special dinner is best, there is a big library through which we can access our books of any kind, many clubs are there which makes it better, Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security, classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and there are gym facilities in each hostel which can be accessed by all students with hostel timings...

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good vibes in the college.
reviews.review_text: There is a huge central library in the college which consists of almost every book possible. There are whiteboards and projectors in mostly every classroom. There are various societies and clubs. In the first year, there is a hostel named 1.8 K Ultra Mega Hostel, and the hostel room is not that big but fine for 2 persons. Quality of food is good; there is breakfast, lunch, and dinner there.

reviews.review_heading: Choose better college than this.
reviews.review_text: We have an auditorium where a movie is screened every week with a good sounding atmosphere. Infrastructure of hostel must be improved. The only problem is about washrooms. They don't even clean them properly. In hostel, two persons are adjusted in one room. Two beds and two study tables are provided. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for Mechanical Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Hostel costs are affordable. There is an ethernet connection, electricity, fan, and cool mineral water in every hostel. The campus is very good. A big library is available for students for free. Good sports facilities and grounds are there. Gym is available for everyone. Many events and festivals are celebrated well. There are lots of clubs students can join to explore and learn. Gym is available. There are also coffee shops in campus, a food street where you can have food or buy necessary items...

reviews.review_heading: Good college and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Some hostels were good but we were not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room not even the iron also the weather was too hot and we were not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Library was good all types of books and technology based books are available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: Definitely you can join this college.
reviews.review_text: NITW is known for its 1.8k hostel. It’s Asia’s largest hostel. The hostel facilities are very wonderful. They provide beds, fans, and lights. The mess quality is also good, but it can be improved. The mess menu should be diversified and should satisfy both North Indian and South Indian students. The vast library possesses excellent books which give students immense knowledge. There are also excellent sports facilities. There is a huge stadium. Students can also enjoy playing different games like...

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure covers all the basic needs: clean water, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for events, a playground for sports, and a well-stocked library. The classrooms are tidy, and there is transportation and on-campus housing for students who need it. The mess is clean and the food is decent, though a few more options would be nice.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Warangal College.
reviews.review_text: On the downside, there are not really enough instructors, and the classrooms are well, they are pretty basic. The canteen menu is kind of limited too mostly just samosas and tea. The campus feels more like a place for cramming for exams rather than a real learning environment. There's no medical facility around. The hostel accommodation is not the best, but they offer some comfort. The mess serves hygienic food, and the water supply is pretty well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: NIT, Warangal is the best NIT in India.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are big enough. Classrooms are chilled with AC and fans. Library is also big enough. Hostel food contains variety of food daily. Canteen is also available. Medical service is for 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: College is a paved path, if you want a good placement, you have to run fast.
reviews.review_text: All over, the college is good, having a lush green campus and a nature-friendly environment,  Wi-Fi is available in the college, and in the hostel, we have LAN ports. Hostel rooms are good, with single and double occupancy. Mess food is good, it might vary from person to person, but for me, it's good.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Warangal College review.
reviews.review_text: The college has solid infrastructure with helpful amenities which is especially great for Science students. We have well-equipped labs and a decent library. For those traveling from afar, the hostel provides enough room. The mess is clean and while the food menu is alright. It would not hurt to add a few more options that students actually enjoy.

admission_overview.title: LPU Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: LPU admission 2026 is mainly entrance-based and a multi-step process starting with application followed by selection rounds, and result declaration. The Lovely Professional University (LPU) offers more than 300 degree and diploma courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels along with several distance learning courses via the LPU Centre for Distance & Online Education. The application process for the university can be completed online. LPU conducts LPUNEST as the in-house entrance and scholarship exam for its courses in fileds of Engineering, Agriculture, Management, Law, Design, Pharmacy, Architecture & Planning, and more. While LPUNEST is widely accepted by the university, if students have valid scores of other national-level entrance exams, such JEE Main Part 2, NATA, CAT, MAT, XAT, etc, they are exempted from appearing for LPUNEST for selective courses. Those who want to improve their scholarships can apply for the LPUNEST exam as well.

faqs.question: Is LPU entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: LPUNEST is a national-level exam conducted by LPU for admission to various courses. LPUNEST forms the basis of eligibility for some programmes and also for the scholarship programmes. The amount of scholarship is determined by the marks and rank obtained by candidates in the exam. LPUNEST exam pattern elucidates the scheme of the question paper. Candidates seeking admission through LPUNEST must check the exam pattern prior to starting the preparation. LPUNEST exam pattern imparts details like total number of question, subjects, marking scheme, exam duration, etc. The entrance test is neither hard nor easy. Candidates must prepare well to score the qualifying marks in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: Will I get a direct admission in LPU with 65 % marks in Class 12?
faqs.answer: LPU does not offer direct admission. However, admission to few courses is merit-based.  Aspirants scoring a 65% aggregate have a good chance of getting admission in LPU. Candidates seeking admission must visit the official website of the university to apply online. To apply for LPU, aspirants need to register for LPUNEST for admission to undergraduate and postgraduate courses. LPU admission to most of the courses is based on LPUNEST score. However, national-level entrance exam scores are also accepted for admission to BA LLB (Hons), MBA, BTech, etc. Candidates must complete Class 12 for UG courses and graduation for PG courses. The selection rounds are followed by counselling and document verification.

faqs.question: What would be the fees if you take a direct admission in the LPU?
faqs.answer: The fee is same for regular and direct admission. LPU fees changes for every course. The top LPU courses along with fee details are mentioned below:Course NameTotal FeeBTechINR 4.5 lakh - INR 16 lakhMBAINR 1.6 lakh - INR 10 lakhBBAINR 3.2 lakh - 9.6 lakhBCAINR 1.5 lakh - 7.2 lakhMCAINR 1.2 lakh - 4.8 lakhNote:This information is gathered from official website and is subject to change.

faqs.question: When will LPU NEST 2026 be conducted?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have registered and booked a slot can appear for the exam. The exam is conducted both remotely and at the exam centres. The remote proctored exam will be conducted from February 15, 2026, and the test centre exam dates are from March 15, 2026.

placement_data.title: Lovely Professional University Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest package offered during LPU placements 2025 stood at INR 2.5 crore per annum and the second highest package stood at INR 1.03 crore per annum. Both packages were offered to the students of BTech Robotics & Automation batch 2025. The average salary offered to the top 25% students stood at INR 10.23 LPA. More than 2,225 recruiters visited the LPU campus and offered over 6,000 job to the students. The top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Accenture, CISCO, TCS, Capgemini, Cognizant, Autodesk, Infosys, Trident, JP Morgan, E&Y, Bosch , etc.

Earlier, the students of the BTech batch 2024 secured the highest package of INR 53 LPA . A total of 1,611 recruiters participated in the placement process and prsented over 7,400 jobs to the students. Microsoft, Google, Infosys, L&T, Amazon, HCL, IBM, TCS, ICICI Bank, etc were among the top recruiters.

reviews.review_heading: It's all about your choice for this MBA course.
reviews.review_text: All the requirements are there. The tools needed to get it. Classrooms and labs have requirements. Wi-Fi is available on campus and in the hotel. The hotels are very good with facilities. The food in the mess is also very good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU - Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: I can't say that the infrastructure is awesome. Our course blocks are clean and well-managed inside. The outside look is average. But the winning facilities are top grade. There is a Good Wi-Fi speed, which is nearly 10 GB per second, but in working hours, it is 2 to 3 GB per second. It is the same in the hostel as well.

reviews.review_heading: I’m strongly satisfied and worth it.
reviews.review_text: 5G Wi-Fi, well-furnished classroom, benches with charging switch, AC, projector and whiteboards. Library with more than 10,000+ books, the latest computer labs, water supplies with a watercooler, garden with sitting benches, greenery flowers, food courts, terrace canteen, malls, sports complex. Hostel rooms are well-established rooms, AC, non-AC (cooler will be there), water cooler in every hostel floor, exercise machines are located in hostel premises, friendly warden, canteen in every hostel, ...

reviews.review_heading: Best college with a good atmosphere and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I'm from B.Tech CSE, and the infrastructure and Wi-Fi are fantastic. The classrooms are maintained very well. The library has a good number of books and a good place to study, and also a hostel is very good. All facilities are there, like games, indoor and outdoor. Good mess food, and there is a medical emergency like having a university hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are not up to the mark, huge opportunities available only if you study hard.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and the hostel were very good. The hostel security is also good, various food will be served for north and south indians students, whatever they want but bit expensive for the hostel and food. The course and the labs were very good to use.

reviews.review_heading: LPU, choosing it is up to you.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good, you get Wi-Fi facility at good speed in both college and hostel. Library is amazing, has a lot of books and even a good place to study; silence is a must. Classrooms are decent. Hostel facilities are decent. Rooms get cleaned often. Mess food might be good some days but will start to hate it. Canteen is good. College is really outstanding when it comes to sports. Inter-hostel tournaments happen. Olympic size swimming pool exists. Two big cricket grounds. Sports complex exists wher...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements in 2022, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the university is in top-notch condition. This is the biggest university in India. All labs and library are well-equipped with air conditioning. Classrooms are well-maintained. Food is ok for South people, but it looks like somewhat difficult to survive on this food. They provide 24X7 medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing facts about Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: For my course, the facilities are quite good. The university is providing computer labs, Wi-Fi and big classrooms. The library is also there, which is very huge and consists of a wide range of books. The hostel is also decent, and the rooms are always clean. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available at any time.

reviews.review_heading: Very good infrastructure and facilities. Good placements, campus life, and facilities are excellent.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of the classes are very good. Labs are also very good, and library facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi is good, but sometimes, due to the large number of students, the network goes down. Hostel facilities are very good. Mess food and canteen are also very good. Medical support is available 24x7. For sports, we have an auditorium where you can play games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: The best infrastructure this college has, alongwith very good placements.
reviews.review_text: On our campus, all facilities are very good. But sometimes we have Wi-Fi speed issues in some blocks, not in labs. The library is open from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Classrooms are digital for every class, we need a laptop mainly for CSE. Faculty are good. In the hostel, most of the facilities are very good, but a few times we have issues with the electricity bill at the end of the year. The gym is present inside the hostels, which is also free. The mess food is good in taste and unlimited. But the m...

reviews.review_heading: The college has beautiful infrastructure, good facilities, and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: The college had number one facilities and beautiful infrastructure. The classrooms for my course were hygienic and clean. Every block contained a library, and free Wi-Fi was available 24/7. The quality of food was not ideal for South Indian students. But overall, it was very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college with excellent infrastructure and strong placement support.
reviews.review_text: B.Tech, BBA, MBA, BCA, and MCA courses are offered. Labs are available, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the hostel and college. The library is very good, with seven floors. Each floor can seat 100–120 students. Food is very good, and three types of food are available. South Indian, North Indian, and combined. Non-veg food is not allowed.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Lovely Institute of Technology, PharmacyReviewed on 17 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: You get placed according to your capacity and capabilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, smart classes, libraries, and even a hospital inside the campus. The campus is even bigger and has its own many areas and food courts. It has many facilities, like an indoor stadium, a pool, many grounds, and even a helipad for helicopter landing.

reviews.review_heading: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Amazed with the college infrastructure as they were offering a number of courses in various sections. For all the sections, 80 percent of seats were enrolled directly and the rest of the enrollment was through management. Fees should vary between direct admission and management quota students. Sports and games were played by us regularly as they were part of our schedule.

reviews.review_heading: Review of LPU  Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: Visiting the hostel rooms seriously made me feel comfortable and much more peaceful in the day to day routine. The perfect environment allowed us to have meaningful college days without any distractions. The fee fixed for all the services was not affordable to all.

college_info.intro:
IIT Gandhinagar popular courses are BTech and MTech. The course curriculum for both courses is flexible. There is a creative learning centre, curriculum-wide project-based learning, a writing studio, and various facilities available for Engineering students. IITGN chemical engineering is also widely pursued by the students. After graduating, BTech and MTech students can work as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Analysts, or take up various other job roles that are relevant to their profile. Overall, IIT Gujarat students are placed in top companies and grab one of the best opportunities available in the job market.
Apart from this, IITGN e-Masters degree programme is also offered for the duration of 2 years. The institute has started accepting applications for batch 2 e-Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation with No GATE score required for admission. The eligibility requirement for the candidates is to have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline such as Engineering, Economics, Law, Commerce, Management, or Finance. In addition to this, a minimum of 60% marks or a 6.0 CGPA is accepted for IIT Gandhinagar e-Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation. Candidates must visit the official website to apply for IIT Gandhinagar e-Masters programme. However, a fee of INR 1000 is mandatory to be made by the candidates. The course comprises six modules spread over 52 credits, with each module lasting 12 to 14 weeks.

reviews.review_text: In the second generation of IITs, IIT Gandhinagar boasts the most beautiful campus and infrastructure. We have free Wi-Fi everywhere on campus and staff to clean the hostel and rooms every day. Good quality mess food. indoor sports complex open for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: Good Infrastructure, placement and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure level is at its peak and design is unique. Facilities provided are Wi-Fi, Labs, Library, Mini Library, Washing Machines, Laundry, Smart, Stationary Shop, Gym, swimming, Hockey, Football, Badminton, Volleyball, Basketball, Fruit shop, Amul shop, General store, Cafes. Hostels are the best.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: The entire curriculum took 18 months to complete. Some aspects covered in the curriculum represented the views on India’s water security. It included the development of learning materials related to the sea security of India. Marine engineering students received special benefits from the course. No, I didn’t opt for the hostel. The hostel fee was Rs. 10,000 per year. The infrastructure was good. Free electricity, free water including hot water, a free table and chair, free Wi-Fi, and free parkin...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for a PhD in Chemistry course.
reviews.review_text: IIT Gandhinagar is located in one of the best locations in India. It has exclusive campuses with a library, exclusive hotels with multiple daily outlets, and two agglomerations. It has a sports stadium with impressive sports facilities, an Olympic-size swimming pool, badminton courts, basketball courts, etc. It also has two cricket and football pitches.

reviews.review_heading: Placement, campus life, research and growth - IIT Gandhinagar.
reviews.review_text: One of the best thing I liked the most about IIT Gandhinagar is its sports facilities. If you are a sportsperson, you should definitely opt this. It has a sports complex which has indoor playing facilities for volleyball, badminton, basketball, and table tennis. Also, 2 indoor swimming pools are also available 24/7 except for Monday, which is the cleaning day. The Gym here is very large and fits with AC. Talking of outdoor games: it has 2 big grounds for cricket with big lights, which are typica...

reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure is very good. I am disappointed by the overall placement.
reviews.review_text: We have good speed of Wi-Fi around 100 MB/s, with fully furnished labs. The classroom and library are amazing. The library also has a kids' zone and full ACs. It's like a wow! It has a very wide collection of books and resources and even contains CDs. We have various shops inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent infrastructure and faculty members. Research culture is groundbreaking.
reviews.review_text: Our college offers a range of facilities designed to support students in their research and learning. Some of them are well-furnished and fully air-conditioned classrooms along with Wi-Fi, advanced teaching aids, smartboards, and multimedia systems to enhance the learning experience. The library is the core of our college with a vast number of academic-related books, along with a good collection of comics, journals, mythology, self-improvement, and biography books. The main library is accessible...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Gandhinagar short review.
reviews.review_text:
It has the best hostel facilities. If you opt for the newly built hostels, they will provide you with triple, double, and single(mostly in final and pre-final year). Each floor has a kitchen with an induction microwave and a fridge. Bathrooms are like for 5-7 people. There is a bathroom mostly all the hostels have bathroom of both ends of the corridor except for the old hostels, which only have 2 bathrooms on each floor, but they are big ones. 
Coming towards the labs for my course, they are als...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Gandhinagar: Pros and cons.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of IIT Gandhinagar is very good and world-class. The hostel and academic buildings have outstanding architecture. High-speed wifi is available all the time. The library is also there where students can go and study; almost all varieties of books are available there. Computer labs are also available for students to use every time.

reviews.review_heading: Best IIT campus in India.
reviews.review_text: In the room, there is one cupboard, one bed mattress and a set of tables and chairs. The process of hostel registration is the same as the admission process. In the morning, there is breakfast; in the afternoon, they provide lunch; in the evening, snacks with tea or coffee; and in the night, they serve dinner.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B.Tech in Electronics from the IIT, Gandhinagar.
reviews.review_text: This college had very good infrastructure for our course. The college had labs for our course with all the required equipment. Wi-Fi, library, sports, canteen, etc. facilities were also available on the college campus for the students. The hostel facility was also available for the students. The food in the hostel mess was good to eat. The quality of the rooms in the hostel was also good.

reviews.review_heading: Great exposure with next level learnings.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good with the Wi-Fi available across the campus. The laboratories are very advanced and the campus has different laboratories as per various discipline options available. The library is well stocked with the latest resources along with the classrooms being modern.

reviews.review_heading: A college with good qualities.
reviews.review_text: If I talk about the infrastructure of the institution, I can say that buildings were creatively made, they were restricted for outsiders to enter the institute, and there were playing areas, libraries, and cultural activities areas over there. The best part of the hostel is the cleanliness maintained by staff, and it serves good food.

reviews.review_heading: Perfect infrastructure and facilities .
reviews.review_text: The college's infrastructure is undoubtedly exceptional. Since it is a 2nd-generation IIT, it is well built with all the facilities provided. The hostels as well as the academic area have comprehensive infrastructure. The food and medical services are of high quality.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college facilities and decent placements great for research oriented students.
reviews.review_text: This is the best part of IIT GN. The hostel rooms are very well maintained, and we have AC's that work at night for a peaceful sleep. Good Wi-Fi and LAN facilities are available. Mess food is pretty decent. The sports complex is really the highlight of the campus. It's really well-equipped. There are two libraries: one in the academic area and one in the student hostel area.

college_info.intro:
The flagship programmes offered at IIT Mandi include BTech and MTech. Admissions to UG & PG courses is based on national-level entrance exams, candidates need to visit the official website of various conducting bodies to fill out the application form and pay the required application fee online. IIT Mandi offers a full-time BTech in nine specialisations. These specialisations include Engineering Physics, Microelectronics & VLSI, Computer Science and Engineering, etc. The duration of these courses is four years, further divided into eight semesters. Additionally, the institute also offers an integrated BTech + MTech in Bioengineering. The duration of the dual-degree programme is five years.
The most sought after BTech specialisations at IIT Mandi include Computer Science, Computational Science, Electronics and Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Data Science, among others. IIT Mandi graduates are placed in eminent organisations such as Amazon, Micorsoft, Infosys, etc.

review_summary.college_name: IIT Mandi Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It's very good and satisfactory, the scenic beauty of the mountains and nature is fabulous.

content.Placements: The mathematics and computing course at IIT Mandi was started in 2023. The placement for the branch has not started yet but the internship of our seniors is very good with most of them securing internships. Some secured internships for the SDE role while others got trading or finance-related roles. Some interned in AI-ML, and some joined the research sector according to their interests. Some companies that have hired interns include Microsoft, Sprinkler, Adobe, Goldman Sachs, and Boconni University's Quant Finance, among others.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus provides good classroom, library and labs facility with very pretty scenic view of the mountains, Wi-Fi facility is very good in labs and library but not that good overall, sports facilities are good but mostly in the South campus so there is problem of up down from one campus to another but have many facilities in North campus also, mess food is decent and campus have decent amount of canteens not much, medical facilities provided is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: The highest package was 65 LPA last year, and the average is around 27 LPA for my branch. Nearly 90 percent+ got placed last year. Top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Nvidia, Flipkart, etc. The same percentage of students got internships, and those were in Google, LibreOffice, etc.
content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi, but it is not optimized to work for Windows, and we have a lot of problems connecting Windows to the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are well structured. The library is also well built and has great facilities. Food in the hostel is sometimes good and sometimes not. Medical facilities are provided for free, and we have a sports complex and a large ground on the campus for most sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Great package, but a small campus.

content.Placements: 100 percent of students have been placed in the computer science course. The highest package is 90 LPA, the lowest is 17 LPA, and the average is 30 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Adobe. Nearly 80 percent of the batch got an internship by 3rd year in companies like Microsoft and Samsung. Top roles offered are SWE and product manager.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure available is great, but less compared to the number of students. Hostel infrastructure and cleanliness are great, but rooms are a bit cramped, the mess food is sometimes good and sometimes very bad. Sports (especially badminton) facilities are great. Medical facilities are also up to date.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is situated in the foothills of Himalayas and provides so much positivity.

content.Placements: It has been 100 percent placement this year. CSE has an average package greater than 29 LPA. The highest package has been around 1 CPA, and the lowest is around 15 LPA. Companies like FAANG, MAANG, and top HFTs have come to our campus. Placement is so awesome, but apparently we have to work hard too.
content.Infrastructure: Department of each branch has huge infrastructure and labs worth 1.5 crores. Everywhere in the campus there is availability of Wi-Fi facilities. Hostels are good, but due to increasing seats, the space might become congested. Mess provides decent food, but it can be worse.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Very strong placements with a peaceful lifestyle in the mountains of the Himalayas.

content.Placements: Almost 95 percent of the total students participating in placements are placed, and it is 100 percent for CSE branch. In CSE, the highest package is 80 LPA, and average was 29 LPA, with the lowest being 6 LPA. Top recruiters were Amazon, Adobe, Infosys, HCL, Microsoft, Mahindra, JP Morgan, Samsung, Tata Motors and TCS. On-campus internship was done by 41% students
content.Infrastructure: There are every possible facilities available in our course, but only thing that may be troublesome for some students is the 4 sharing rooms for 1st year students. Mess food quality also decreased after a couple of months, but is restored upon complaint to the dean's office.

reviews.review_heading: It's very good and satisfactory, the scenic beauty of the mountains and nature is fabulous.
reviews.review_text: Our campus provides good classroom, library and labs facility with very pretty scenic view of the mountains, Wi-Fi facility is very good in labs and library but not that good overall, sports facilities are good but mostly in the South campus so there is problem of up down from one campus to another but have many facilities in North campus also, mess food is decent and campus have decent amount of canteens not much, medical facilities provided is good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi, but it is not optimized to work for Windows, and we have a lot of problems connecting Windows to the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are well structured. The library is also well built and has great facilities. Food in the hostel is sometimes good and sometimes not. Medical facilities are provided for free, and we have a sports complex and a large ground on the campus for most sports.

reviews.review_heading: Great package, but a small campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available is great, but less compared to the number of students. Hostel infrastructure and cleanliness are great, but rooms are a bit cramped, the mess food is sometimes good and sometimes very bad. Sports (especially badminton) facilities are great. Medical facilities are also up to date.

reviews.review_heading: College is situated in the foothills of Himalayas and provides so much positivity.
reviews.review_text: Department of each branch has huge infrastructure and labs worth 1.5 crores. Everywhere in the campus there is availability of Wi-Fi facilities. Hostels are good, but due to increasing seats, the space might become congested. Mess provides decent food, but it can be worse.

reviews.review_heading: Very strong placements with a peaceful lifestyle in the mountains of the Himalayas.
reviews.review_text: There are every possible facilities available in our course, but only thing that may be troublesome for some students is the 4 sharing rooms for 1st year students. Mess food quality also decreased after a couple of months, but is restored upon complaint to the dean's office.

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics, great exposure and college provide everything you need except money for fests.
reviews.review_text: Bio engineering at IIT Mandi has smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, advanced labs and a well stocked central library. Hostels are clean with good amenities, the mess food is decent, medical facilities are available on campus and sports facilities are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities, but they can always be better.
reviews.review_text: It's a newer IIT that is second-generation III, so the hostels are good. One thing I don't like is that we are four people in a room, which I think is a room for 2 people. The Wi-Fi facility is good. The food can be better, and for sports and games, it's above satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi.
reviews.review_text: We all know that the infrastructure and facilities of any IIT college are top-class. IIT Mandi is no exception. The entire campus of IIT Mandi is divided into two parts - the North Campus and the South Campus. There are around 10 hostels in IIT Mandi. Each room has a bed, study desk, chair, wardrobe, and attached bathroom.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely loving it, it's a different place, good interactions, lovely nature, and best placements.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good, I mean nice bus, not as good as it could be because of obvious reasons, the physical location of IIT Mandi is in the mountains and there it is not possible to construct such big buildings, but we are provided with common room, pantry room, vending machines shared between hostels nearby, study room, washing machines, and fridge all.

reviews.review_heading: It's the most beautiful college with such a beautiful environment, It's lovely.
reviews.review_text: The course curriculum is good, and all the required facilities are in the hostel as well. We have laundry, a pantry, sports rooms, a fan, a table, a chair, and an almira (cupboard), everything in our rooms. Wi-Fi facilities, well-established labs, and nice classrooms with a projector, board and AC.

reviews.review_heading: Collection is awesome, such a beautiful location.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteens, medical, classroom with AC, sports, mess, and all are available on campus. We have common room, study room, Wi-Fi, vending machine, pantry room, and laundry room. We also have table, chair, and almirah in hostel. Its a good experience to live on such a beautiful campus.

reviews.review_heading: Heaven in mountains - IIT Mandi.
reviews.review_text: Classes are in very good condition, and the cleanliness is top-tier. For summer, there is air conditioning, and for winter, there are heaters. The Wi-Fi is also good. The mess food is good, and sports facilities are very good. All the grounds are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Mandi has excellent placement, infrastructure, faculty and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of courses in IIT Mandi is excellent. Free Wi-Fi is available for students in every hostel, classroom, and library. All buildings of IIT Mandi are new. Classrooms have AC facility, charging points at every bench, a study environment, and are in excellent condition. A central library is present there which contains over 50,000 books. Hostel facility is also excellent in IIT Mandi. There are available indoor games (table tennis, etc.), washing machines, Wi-Fi, theater, geysers, ...

reviews.review_heading: It has pretty good infrastructure, good research Is going on and has good placements in 2023.
reviews.review_text: Since it's a 2009 built IIT, it has pretty good infrastructure. It has all the required labs with all the necessary equipment. college_info.intro:
VNIT Nagpur offers various Undergraduate, Postgraduate and PhD courses. Among them, the flagship courses are BTech and BArch. The full-time BTech programme is offered in eight streams. After doing BTech in Civil Engineering, students can work in aspects like planning, design, construction and operations within the Civil Engineering sector. Students will also be able to learn about Numerical Analysis and Probability Theory, Digital Circuits and Microprocessor, Concepts in Programming Languages etc after pursuing BTech in Computer Science and Engineering. For BTech admission, students need to pass Class 12 from a recognised board in Science stream (PCM) with minimum of 75% aggregate.
BArch admission is based on JEE Main exam, followed by JoSAA Counselling. Students will be able to learn about Graphics, Visual Arts, Construction, Architectural Design etc after doing BArch course. overview_faqs.question: When was VNIT Nagpur established?
overview_faqs.answer: VNIT Nagpur, established in 1960, is one of the the oldest NITs in the country. All the programmes offered at VNIT Nagpur are approved by the UGC. VNIT Nagpur offers UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes in the fields of Engineering, Architecture, Science and Technology. Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology course admission is based on entrance exams, such as JEE Main, GATE, DASA UG, IIT JAM and NATA.
